body:
Kim’s SCREEN Act would enable the CDC to create a national campaign raising awareness for type 1 diabetes, ensuring that all Americans have the knowledge and resources they need for early detection and management of this condition. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87355520/480878779/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzgyMjVhNC0yYTMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ggiZ569EfEkTr6cEYE24exq5VbeHJs3molVK1oDa2IU=&emci=e4a3c78d-0c30-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=bc8225a4-2a30-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=15820338)
---
Peter,

Just last week, Kim Schrier introduced the Strengthening Collective Resources for Encouraging Education Needed (SCREEN) for Type 1 Diabetes Act, a critical piece of legislation aimed at raising awareness for type 1 diabetes testing.

As someone who lives with type 1 diabetes, Kim knows firsthand how crucial a timely diagnosis can be. **Managing this tough disease requires the full attention of both the individual and their doctor.** That’s why it’s so important that people get the testing they require and feel empowered to ask for testing if they suspect they might need it.

Kim’s SCREEN Act would enable the CDC to create a national campaign raising awareness for type 1 diabetes, _ensuring that all Americans have the knowledge and resources they need for early detection and management of this condition._

| **Records Detail Federal-State Censorship Coordination in 2020 Election

[](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32790&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdmlkZW9zL2JpZGVuLWZpdC1vci11bmZpdC1mb3Itb2ZmaWNlLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=966c3392d31e39457ad467a8bec31a931b97c594c73e48091a6c2470ee667d79)**
We received[ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32739&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXZzLWRocy0xMTAtcmVjb3Jkcy0wMzU2MC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=87b6920a79a2b550daacfa536322c9d9df8978b47f7b044641337117fe3d0858)[110 pages](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32739&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXZzLWRocy0xMTAtcmVjb3Jkcy0wMzU2MC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=87b6920a79a2b550daacfa536322c9d9df8978b47f7b044641337117fe3d0858) of heavily redacted records from the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit that show state election officials in the days before and after the 2020 election flagging online content deemed “misinformation.”

They sent these online posts to the Center for Internet Security (CIS), a DHS-funded nonprofit, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), the Election Integrity Partnership (EIP), and others.

The records provide more disturbing evidence of a conspiracy by federal, state, and “private” actors to censor Americans on social media during a presidential campaign
Judicial Watch obtained the records in response to our [lawsuit](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=28502&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZGhzLWNlbnNvcnNoaXAtcmVxdWVzdHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=6de7cd770c319985aec4b4e64cf7080991aeff206eea30e1bc622dace3e0063e) for records of communications between the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), a division of DHS, and the Election Integrity Partnership (EIP), which was created to suppress online election content ([_Judicial Watch Inc. vs. U.S. Department of Homeland Security_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=28508&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZGhzLWVsZWN0aW9uLWludGVncml0eS1wYXJ0bmVyc2hpcC1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDM1NjAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=163ea6db74ad5165ce474ed5b6393e8822493138699a3f48f145946b96445360) (No. 1:22-cv-03560 )). We filed suit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after DHS failed to respond to an October 2022 FOIA request.

The newly obtained records include a November 4, 2020,[ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32740&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXZzLWRocy0xMTAtcmVjb3Jkcy0wMzU2MC1wZ3MtNzUtNzY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5e896916ecbf380c906f4ebef15ca15a4c73daa635115e26fad45cd87c704741)[email](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32740&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXZzLWRocy0xMTAtcmVjb3Jkcy0wMzU2MC1wZ3MtNzUtNzY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5e896916ecbf380c906f4ebef15ca15a4c73daa635115e26fad45cd87c704741) report from CIS “Misinformation Reports” to Brian Scully, head of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Mis-, Dis-, Malinformation (MDM) branch, a division of DHS. The report originated in the Washington State secretary of state’s office and states:
> I wanted to flag the following tweet: [handle redacted]. There is no evidence for the claim being made of a widespread mail-in fraud operation to benefit Democrats in swing states.
The flagged tweet reads:
> A note to ALL CONSERVATIVE media people projecting Trump victories in swing states:
>
> Yes, Republican turn out may be strong!
>
> Yes, that’s good news.
>
> From a mail in state veteran: The Democrats will wait to know how many votes they have to “find”, then, they will magically appear.
On November 12, 2020, Scully sends an[ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32741&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXZzLWRocy0xMTAtcmVjb3Jkcy0wMzU2MC1wZy0xMT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=c916a2301bc19a2f7c0859defbf7018a4326b139ce64a57c13baba8ba03aae53)[email](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32741&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXZzLWRocy0xMTAtcmVjb3Jkcy0wMzU2MC1wZy0xMT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=c916a2301bc19a2f7c0859defbf7018a4326b139ce64a57c13baba8ba03aae53) with subject line “Hammer and Scorecard Tweets” to individuals whose names are redacted and have a @gmail email address a @stanford.edu email address respectively. Scully introduces the “program manager for the EIP” at Stanford University and who is “a friend of Director Krebs” (former CISA Director[ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32742&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9ueXBvc3QuY29tLzIwMjAvMTEvMTcvdHJ1bXAtZmlyZXMtY3liZXItaGVhZC1jaHJpcy1rcmVicy1mb3ItZGlzbWlzc2luZy12b3Rlci1mcmF1ZC1jbGFpbXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=bc4ade60da9709be3f9b8d070d98214b3b651616652cca17791024898bcc480d)[Chris Krebs](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68798&L=32742&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9ueXBvc3QuY29tLzIwMjAvMTEvMTcvdHJ1bXAtZmlyZXMtY3liZXItaGVhZC1jaHJpcy1rcmVicy1mb3ItZGlzbWlzc2luZy12b3Rlci1mcmF1ZC1jbGFpbXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=bc4ade60da9709be3f9b8d070d98214b3b651616652cca17791024898bcc480d)).

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: this church has gone too far
body:
Some churches would have you believe Jesus supports abortion...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

My jaw hit the floor when I read this article from the _Dallas Morning News._

A church in Texas just announced they're forming a "Pregnancy Resource Center" – which, normally, would be a great thing.

But the Pregnancy Resource Center this church is forming isn't designed to save lives; it's designed to end them!

I know the media LOVES THIS. But I want to know what you think . . .

That's why I'm counting on you to fill out your **[Keep the Faith Survey](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-ggtdly-duchtdja-y/)** IMMEDIATELY.

Pro-Life Friend, the First Unitarian Church of Dallas, Texas – _a state that has acted to prevent the killing of preborn babies_ – would have you believe Jesus supports abortion!

They claim their church’s “Pregnancy Resource Center” helps to “combat misinformation” from life-saving, pro-life Pregnancy Resource Centers.

So, they’re helping to traffic women across state lines for abortions – and bragging about it!

And that’s not the only way the Abortion Lobby is scheming to get around life-saving laws.

_USA Today_ reports that in 2023, 63% of abortions were committed using Chemical Abortion Pills and that about 8,000 women per month get these dangerous pills in states with pro-life laws.

Which is why we need your help.

In addition to **[filling out your Keep the Faith Survey](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-ggtdly-duchtdja-j/),** could you please **[give your most generous contribution to help _Students for Life Action_ continue our critical work battling Chemical Abortion Pills](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-ggtdly-duchtdja-i/)?**

By contributing to _Students for Life Action,_ you help us battle dangerous Chemical Abortion Pills as we:

**>>>** Hit college campuses to explain to students how Chemical Abortion Pills "work" – by STARVING and EXPELLING the baby;

**>>>** Expose how Chemical Abortion Pills are poisoning our country’s water supply with harmful chemicals and human remains – a tactic that is proven to be a leading way to bring young people to the pro-life cause; and

**>>>** Warn college students about how at least 32 women have died as a result of these pills – in addition to the hundreds of thousands of preborn deaths.
We can’t afford to let _Planned Parenthood_ have the final say on college campuses, especially regarding Chemical Abortion Pills.

So please, **[fill out your Keep the Faith Survey](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-ggtdly-duchtdja-d/)** as soon as possible and **[make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-ggtdly-duchtdja-h/)!**

Thanks for all you do for life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Ready to kickstart your retirement? Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan. But with thousands of options available, knowing where to start can seem daunting. That’s why SmartAsset created a [no-cost tool](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1c5pirfc5o7k1bm1fmcpn300er06fpopgvq0v6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im8pj2chh2bs) to help match you with up to three financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform are rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and legally bound to work in your best interest.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor:
* feel more at ease about their finances

body:
Bob Casey is completely OUT OF TOUCH

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0ce5q7rupt4e3tqvtktqsoppk170ql4ndk1ten8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2o36clh2bs)

Friend,

As the father of daughters, I can't imagine my girls being required to share a locker room or a playing field with biological men.

That's why I did a double-take when I saw this headline about my opponent, Bob Casey.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zivnkjg7jo7se1qd0p54c3a6fncdoamde1s4tup0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2o36clh2bs)

**Bob Casey is completely OUT OF TOUCH.** But, that's what we've come to expect from career politicians like Casey who have spent 18 years in Washington, and it's why the polls show us closing the gap in what will be one of the most competitive Senate races this year.

Will you stand with me and add your name to our petition to _**[SAVE WOMEN'S SPORTS?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs31gknt9i50efm14m1i1banindgpro62kkpf68g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2o36clh2bs)**_
[SAVE WOMEN'S SPORTS: SIGN THE PETITION!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrj9tpup3affvthn7hrdlct2luom7jrmf6d3arqo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2o36clh2bs)
---
**Some things are just basic right vs. wrong.** Boys and girls have biological differences. But Bob Casey _believes the advantage biological boys have when competing against biological girls is "overgeneralized" and "unfounded." _

I may not be a medical professional, but I don't think it's an overgeneralization to state that boys are different from girls. If we let politicians like Bob Casey get reelected, we risk losing women's sports forever.

Two years ago, Pennsylvania was ground zero in the fight to save women's sports. The fight is NOT OVER. We have an opportunity to defeat Casey and flip the Senate majority, but it's going to be a tough fight. **I 'm no stranger to tough fights - from my days as a West Point cadet to the battlefield in Iraq, I've learned the fight for America's future will take every one of us stepping up to do what we can. **

**I 'm a believer in the power of grassroots support, so I'm asking you to step up TODAY to [sign the petition to save women's sports.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znpbcrdk394nq7lp959rda881ubfc7c4aoc5oe4o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2o36clh2bs)** After adding your name, you'll have an opportunity to pitch in to help me defeat Bob Casey. _If you are able to, I 'm asking you to please chip in $15, $25, $50, or more to help me win this battleground Senate race in Pennsylvania. _
Your support is fueling our campaign as we head into the summer. We're making ground and closing the polling gap by showing voters who Bob Casey REALLY is. I'm so grateful for your support in this fight.

Thank you,

Dave McCormick

P.S. I'm a proud girl dad who wants every woman to be able to compete and thrive through participation in athletics. We're at risk of losing women's sports and I won't let career politicians like Bob Casey continue to gaslight the American public by saying biological men don't have an advantage over biological women. If you agree, **[please add your name to our petition today!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za2cq6oc0jc4gedrl16ojtbmc6es1tnpe7lfd53g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2o36clh2bs) **

name: Dave McCormick
subject: Save Women's Sports: Sign the Petition
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick
body:
Bob Casey is completely OUT OF TOUCH

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z6vrcggqpshhig1taeniqb1m1d9o2degun5u9kig_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2p72c5h2bs)

Friend,

As the father of daughters, I can't imagine my girls being required to share a locker room or a playing field with biological men.

That's why I did a double-take when I saw this headline about my opponent, Bob Casey.

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjq3f3ifgikhkorpoa3k51qcpofb1j8u3k20ntk0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2p72c5h2bs)

**Bob Casey is completely OUT OF TOUCH.** But, that's what we've come to expect from career politicians like Casey who have spent 18 years in Washington, and it's why the polls show us closing the gap in what will be one of the most competitive Senate races this year.

Will you stand with me and add your name to our petition to _**[SAVE WOMEN'S SPORTS?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zaf4gs34si57dv4qebrqlv375dgtts3gidbec2ig_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2p72c5h2bs)**_
[SAVE WOMEN'S SPORTS: SIGN THE PETITION!](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zj2ruiphd0uqsu9tt2dct871b4qmcni33fq510vg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2p72c5h2bs)
---
**Some things are just basic right vs. wrong.** Boys and girls have biological differences. But Bob Casey _believes the advantage biological boys have when competing against biological girls is "overgeneralized" and "unfounded." _

I may not be a medical professional, but I don't think it's an overgeneralization to state that boys are different from girls. If we let politicians like Bob Casey get reelected, we risk losing women's sports forever.

Two years ago, Pennsylvania was ground zero in the fight to save women's sports. The fight is NOT OVER. We have an opportunity to defeat Casey and flip the Senate majority, but it's going to be a tough fight. **I 'm no stranger to tough fights - from my days as a West Point cadet to the battlefield in Iraq, I've learned the fight for America's future will take every one of us stepping up to do what we can. **

**I 'm a believer in the power of grassroots support, so I'm asking you to step up TODAY to [sign the petition to save women's sports.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zs3guq09g6r64q6smfuelobrb0fm7099k2ghsrdg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2p72c5h2bs)** After adding your name, you'll have an opportunity to pitch in to help me defeat Bob Casey. _If you are able to, I 'm asking you to please chip in $15, $25, $50, or more to help me win this battleground Senate race in Pennsylvania. _
Your support is fueling our campaign as we head into the summer. We're making ground and closing the polling gap by showing voters who Bob Casey REALLY is. I'm so grateful for your support in this fight.

Thank you,

Dave McCormick

P.S. I'm a proud girl dad who wants every woman to be able to compete and thrive through participation in athletics. We're at risk of losing women's sports and I won't let career politicians like Bob Casey continue to gaslight the American public by saying biological men don't have an advantage over biological women. If you agree, **[please add your name to our petition today!](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztf2k3rg6gnsqapqivm2oi2f1lagds752g3qcvu8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s1im2p72c5h2bs) **

body:

Friend,

Something disturbing is unfolding in our country, and the American people are beginning to uncover big secrets.

Recently, it has been revealed that P. Diddy, a famous rap artist, may be involved in sex trafficking, blackmail, and inappropriate relations with underage children.

And worse...

Nickelodeon, a popular children’s entertainment channel, has been exposed for knowingly employing or hiring sex offenders that target children.

Did you know that Nickelodeon, P. Diddy, and government indoctrination all have something in common?

**_Predators who target children do everything in their power to SEPARATE children from their families_.**

Let me explain.

Critical Race Theory, woke educators, and radicals in the transgender movement all recognize that the greatest threat to their objectives is the family unit and traditional moral values; parents are the obstacle. In order to manipulate children into twisted ideas or acts, government indoctrination centers must brainwash children into hating the so-called “patriarchy” (in other words, getting them to despise their father), teach them to resent their privilege and family status, and worse, instruct them that they are being oppressed by their family.

Sadly, one of the primary missions of predators like P. Diddy and Nickelodeon staff members was manipulating children to leave their families, convincing them they were being oppressed as well.

**The nuclear family is the last line of defense against the forces of cultural Marxism, socialism, and dangerous predators in the media.**

I created the Tuttle Twins when I had children and discovered there were no resources to teach children about basic concepts such as liberty, capitalism, American History, and why the family unit is so important.

The Tuttle Twins series brings families together and seeks to strengthen those bonds rather than rip them apart.

Government indoctrination centers are NOT teaching children about the principles that forged this country into a free and prosperous nation. In fact, they are teaching using the classroom as a pulpit to brainwash children into obedient serfs of the state.

You and I must put an end to this madness.

Families teach children about personal responsibility, morality, faith, and truth and safeguard young ones from danger and predators.

On June 19, 1865, Union soldiers landed at Galveston with news that the Civil War was over and that the enslaved were now free. On Juneteenth, Governor Youngkin and First Lady Suzanne S. First Lady Suzanne S. Youngkin participated in a forum to raise awareness of the dangers of fentanyl to a group of concerned Loudoun County parents and students. Other panelists included Attorney General Miyares, DEA agent Shane Todd, Loudoun County Sheriff Mike Chapman, and mother Jen Breaux, who lost her son to fentanyl poisoning. The "One Pill Can Kill" Fentanyl Awareness and Narcan Training event is one of many forums the First Lady has attended across the Commonwealth this year. Further, Mrs. Youngkin and the Virginia Department of Health launched "It Only Takes One" awareness campaign in Roanoke earlier this year. The first-of-its-kind Virginia campaign is an all-hands on deck approach with community stakeholders including parents, coaches, teachers, local businesses, and nonprofits. More information can be found at [www.itonlytakesoneva.com](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=28d577f0506ccfa8c704feba0096af3f1735635fb68a07b555af0bb6718263c34ddeb88a7233acf467dff2371bad5c63c8948191b6834fd7ec38e3f800cc64eb "www.itonlytakesoneva.com").

This week, Governor Youngkin announced that Condair Group AG, an international evaporative technologies manufacturing company, will invest $57.2 million to establish a new production facility in Chesterfield County and create 180 new jobs.

"Virginia is the epicenter of the growing data center industry, and we applaud the 21st century manufacturing jobs that Condair Group AG are bringing to the Commonwealth," Governor Youngkin said.

Governor Youngkin also announced that 11 companies across the Commonwealth will graduate from the Virginia Economic Development Partnership's (VEDP) Virginia Leaders in Export Trade (VALET) program and 14 companies will join the two-year program. VALET, which now has 402 graduated companies, assists Virginia exporters that have firmly established domestic operations and are committed to international exporting as a growth strategy.

This week our nation recognized Juneteenth -- a moment to recount the events of June 19th, 1865 (two months after the end of the Civil War and two-and-a-half years after the issuance of the Emancipation Proclamation) when 250,000 enslaved individuals in Galveston, Texas were finally informed of their freedom. A poignant moment in United States' #homehistory, 'Emancipation Day' was celebrated annually thereafter by Black Richmonders into the early 1900s, as pictured here. Serving as an opportunity to further honor the resilience and strength of the African American community, the commemoration of these historical moments is imperative to our national identity and the Spirit of Virginia.

| | | I've been on live TV more times than I can count...

## SCOTUS Bans Guns for Domestic Abuse Suspects
The Supreme Court upheld [a 30-year-old law](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOhCAQQL8GujUwciAFxTV2e-2VZsRR54KyUSLZ-_rLXr3dS17ykvd9H-7IifflCzcKZc4DxsIXDfYGcAMzGDmFmQiolRS0015Z3Vot16Dt3LXG29h57XCMc9TGK484ElCHVnIABUZZAOVBf0ADkxmhI-VId4jOCKNo4pKP5ifzXlaa0zNfdDQxbzKFtZTHKdpPAb2AvtbajGN8OQH9TvUU0ONROCZ6YXw6tzhl0vSb5RGmR-WU-LROGLVsyOm_Wt4_XgH-AgAA__9rwFLt) on Friday that bars people with restraining orders for domestic abuse from owning firearms. Chief Justice John Roberts described the ruling as "common sense." In an 8-1 decision, [the Justices found ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1ugzAUxfGngc2RffFXBg9dsqVrR-TYh-RWBiNwiPr2VTp3PDrLT_-v63iNXHi5f8YZoU11jKnxgdEKIkF61H0OE0AYegTl1FlaNVjVP8LkvIcxt8HbfCMLGHX2MkblQNpE6jmQJC0tkTyTMnSirG_kIR2Uj9HpTktkbnU7fVde2gNT-akHtlOqc1_Co7V174aPji4dXeK64LW_r_fYGqeCji77c90wQ6T63Jq4P5dd5Dpjb5zEwbVgSRDZDoAn_yYqlZKBiVI5Lz3JiUj3W8jri0vh3bpOy_scufwp2v9NjkC_AQAA__-CzWI0)that historically, gun laws often included provisions preventing individuals "who threaten physical harm to others from misusing firearms." Justice Clarence Thomas was [the lone dissenter](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOtCAYRZ8GOwxeEZyC4m_o5m-3NCifIxsVAzhm3n7j1tud4iT35nw9h6cLa9hf_91GpsxxcFMJbxoUBzjkICtvZiJQW5FpdPMQqmlVUy1Gydm3euyFa-d-JHTwbQ_t0HUgrVQVDASkUIB4oOlQw8sRPQlNTe-clkwK8qHEVH_HsJeF5vUT35TqKW7VapZSjszafwyWwV7XVZ_Zlejd5xYYbC4xfRjsTldmsEdcQwnTjfcwgxXq5uZWzyPRRnyKZyrc0xRyiDv3caNcwsTdeGZKmb_Oncdrp5SXcDBYDdUDshVCM9gqGX9cYV1DVppJ8dpcWH_flr_bvQ1-AgAA__-xhW9h), saying there wasn't a "single historical regulation" that justified the ban.
## California Mayor Under Federal Investigation
Oakland, California Mayor Sheng [Thao hired a criminal defense attorney](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fy6yAQQNGvQR0aWCGwC4rXqPNrU2rWYrE3RsKDiBj9fSapU9_izvm4zTfkxNvjP67ka8wzLpUPmq0EkGBm0wUfiYCGjrx2-qqsHqzunj4CjdGCi-aOzjmkqzbjOF5gWeIyqKFjDwqMsgDqCnqEHoK5w4WUI31BdEYYRYFrLv1n5q0-KaYzH1T6Ja9d8s9a37sY_gmYBEyttf5Vj6-fKGDaqO0CpoyvhFuQK565yEIVedtlwnZSkRgrFRnvLAty6IoP78Yp8W6dMOqxIqffVf0bfnj4DgAA__8YrVvj) on Friday, one day after FBI agents raided her home as part of a multi-agency corruption investigation. Federal authorities [conducted a raid](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNiL7MAYGD12ypWtHdD6fk2uNjcAiyt9X6dzx6S1P7-u23FCS5PsnruxqLAtSlZMX2wF0YBbTBheZgfuWnR71rKzurW4fbhin6Cf2DCEE1oMyQEPseZ4s-UnFVhwoMMoCqBn0ABcIxsPEamQ9IY6mMYqD1LJfvovk-uCYXuXk_UJlbZN71LodTf_RwLWBK26Zn8dbvWGvQokbuBb8SZhDt-Kr7F300kk--ahyxyold30wgyaOBCMR2mhJh5kJA0Lvyc_t7sL2lJTksGNj1H1FSX8B9f8dp4PfAAAA__-OI2LF) on a home belonging to Thao Thursday morning as part of a public corruption case, with the FBI, IRS, and US Postal Service working together. Agents were seen carrying boxes out of the home. Agents [also searched ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnwRsRHBfAA0MXb-na0Tqbc0yLTWSoo7x91c6d_-GXvo_beKOU035_p41DW8pIc0snj1YCSMARuxgWZmDTcdBO98pqY3W3BjQ9scXeTuiv6OJse_baeWemJZrZdimAAlQWQPWgr3CBiBN4Vo61J3IoUHFMrRyXz5L2tvKSX-Xk4zKXrcthbe1RhXkTMAgYaJrdzs_6GwUMj1KbgGGZkjwoRY6y0FemPcqNXuWQdeX9LttKpcq1bCxr-T5mrgIGjb1XV-MFDN0R4uOZck7VOoHqvlHKf_v2P8YZ4CcAAP__ww9gew)the offices of California Waste Solutions and the homes of at least two California Waste Solutions employees. Thao's lawyer said she had nothing to hide and would cooperate with the investigation.

| Hey, it’s Al Franken. [I’m writing because I want you to split $50 or whatever you can (or more than you can) between Blue Amp Action and my friend Josh Riley to help him win one of the most important races in the country in 2024.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta0d5e926-0317-4ffb-af68-55cb50a618f7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Josh is running for Congress in New York’s 19th District, a key district to taking back the House. Here’s why I support Josh — and why you should too! Josh knows policy issues backward and forward. Together Josh and I did good stuff when he was my counsel on the U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee – good stuff like protecting victims of domestic violence. In the Violence Against Women Act, Josh and I wrote a provision that protected survivors of domestic violence from homelessness. And Josh and I got that protection through a divided Senate, a Republican House, and signed into law. Republicans lie and say Josh was bad on crime, but here’s the truth. Josh and I advanced legislation that funded the police! Providing bullet-proof vests for local and state police. And funding crisis intervention training to teach police officers how to de-escalate situations. Together in the Senate, we also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad at hearings when we cross-examined them. Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about. And he is the hardest worker I know. And finally, NY-19 is considered a tossup and one of the most competitive in the nation. [So, what do you say? Will you join me by splitting a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T40c05064-3c1c-4d8e-98d9-804ec45fab53/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: When will Mississippi wake up to school choice?
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards-11572728?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**Mississippi is almost surrounded by states that have school choice. Why don’t we? **
---
|
---
_Why doesn't Mississippi have school choice?_
| **Last week Governor Jeff Landry of Louisiana signed into law the Gator Scholarship program.** From 2025, Louisiana families can receive state funds to pay for educational expenses to meet their child’s individual needs.

Alabama passed similar legislation a few months ago. Arkansas did something similar in 2023.

**In Mississippi, nothing. Why? **

It is not as if Mississippi doesn’t have a conservative majority. Conservatives have been in charge of the Mississippi House, Senate and Governor's mansion since 2012.

Conservatives in Alabama and Arkansas have had control for about the same length of time as in our state. Somehow, they seem to have done something with it.

**_Louisiana conservatives have achieved more school choice in 12 months than Mississippi conservatives have managed in 12 years._** Gov Landry only won back the Governor’s Mansion last year and he signed school choice into law last week.
---
|
---
_Louisiana's Gov Landry leading_
| **_A major part of the problem is that many leaders in Mississippi refuse to see the need for reform._** They want to believe that education standards are improving and that there’s just not much need to change.

**_Here’s why they are wrong:_**
* **1 in 4 school children in our state are chronically absent.** That’s 108,310 children in 2022-23, up dramatically from 70,275 in 2016-17.

If Mississippi education is as good as they say it is, why are so many kids not showing up?
* **8 out of 10 eighth ****grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient in math in 2022. **
* Almost 7 in 10 fourth grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient in reading in 2022.

**How many Mississippi politicians would be willing to send their kids to a school with those standards?** So why are they willing to see other kids exposed to those kind of averages and pretend all is fine and dandy?
* **Almost 4 in 10 fourth graders in 2022 did not even reach the __basic__ reading standard.**

Let’s quit pretending things are fine when our current system is unable to teach ten year olds the basics of reading.

Reform is difficult. If you are a conservative, overhauling anything involving the public sector means stirring up a hornet’s nest of opposition. It’s easier to buddy up to the absurdly misnamed “Parent’s Campaign” and defend the status quo. I get all that.

**_But here’s why Mississippi conservatives absolutely have to use the majority they have to achieve school choice. _**

**Over the past thirty years, we have seen the ideological takeover of much of America by the far left.** If I had told you at the time of the Iraq war or even when Obama was in the White House that American students would be protesting in support of Hamas in 2024, I would not have believed you. Today it happens frequently.

**A generation ago, corporate America did not demand to know your preferred pronouns.** Today you can hardly apply for a job at a big firm without doing so.
---
|
---
_Left wing ideas move from education into the workplace._
| Where do you think this ideological extremism came from? It has been made possible by the influence of critical theory ideologues on our education system.

**Of course, not every school is a hotbed of ‘woke’ intersectional ideology. But the only way to stop the advance of ‘woke’ ideology in America is to give parents back control over their child’s education.**

The lesson of the past 30 years is that unless conservative America has a plan to take back control of the education system, the left will win. It is not enough to run for office as a conservative because happen to hunt or have the right bumper stickers on your truck.

**Conservatives in office who do nothing to advance school choice are assisting, however unwittingly, the radical left in their capture of this country.**

We cannot afford another decade of wasted opportunities to achieve school choice.

Have an awesome weekend!
---

---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

Dear Peter,
November 5 will be here before we know it. With that in mind, I want to share an important message.
With political tensions rising and the campaign rancor getting more personal, more vicious and uglier, I am focused on what the American people care about – peace, freedom and prosperity.
The major parties keep ratcheting up the political tension, but they do not address the needs, desires and solutions that make everyday Americans’ lives better. Instead of uniting, they divide.
I will not contribute to that kind of dirty politics. While the other campaigns fight for party power, I will fight for power to be returned to you, the people.
Running as an independent, I am able to focus on the issues and solutions that make your life better, not pay them lip service.
I intend to unite the country by focusing on innovative solutions that transcend party lines, like:
* Restoring the middle class with good jobs and affordable home ownership;
* Revitalizing small businesses;
* Ending the chronic disease epidemic affecting half our children;
* Securing our borders – especially from the drug cartels;
* Protecting our rivers and shorelines; and
* Freeing federal agencies from corporate control.

These are not partisan issues; they are American issues—issues that require us to come together for the common good.
The fact that November 5 will soon be upon us only underscores the urgency of our mission together.
If you believe in these goals too, then please support my campaign and help me change American politics and restore the American Dream.
Together we can restore our great country, not only when I get into the White House but also on my way there. Join me and show your independence!
[Help Me Change American Politics](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healing_america_6_22_24_rs_nd1&n=5)
| |
---
---
Sincerely,
Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

clean_body: I am focused on what the American people care about – peace, freedom and prosperity. | | | | | | | Dear Peter, November 5 will be here before we know it. With that in mind, I want to share an important message. With political tensions rising and the campaign rancor getting more personal, more vicious and uglier, I am focused on what the American people care about – peace, freedom and prosperity. The major parties keep ratcheting up the political tension, but they do not address the needs, desires and solutions that make everyday Americans’ lives better. Instead of uniting, they divide. I will not contribute to that kind of dirty politics. While the other campaigns fight for party power, I will fight for power to be returned to you, the people. Running as an independent, I am able to focus on the issues and solutions that make your life better, not pay them lip service. I intend to unite the country by focusing on innovative solutions that transcend party lines, like: Restoring the middle class with good jobs and affordable home ownership; Revitalizing small businesses; Ending the chronic disease epidemic affecting half our children; Securing our borders – especially from the drug cartels; Protecting our rivers and shorelines; and Freeing federal agencies from corporate control. These are not partisan issues; they are American issues—issues that require us to come together for the common good. The fact that November 5 will soon be upon us only underscores the urgency of our mission together. If you believe in these goals too, then please support my campaign and help me change American politics and restore the American Dream. Together we can restore our great country, not only when I get into the White House but also on my way there. Join me and show your independence! | | Sincerely, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. | | | PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY Would you like help donating? Call: tel:8057289443 and you can get help from a campaign staffer.

As the father of daughters, I can't imagine my girls being required to share a locker room or a playing field with biological men.

That's why I did a double-take when I saw this headline about my opponent, Bob Casey.

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=61d6c63bc2564390b0cb058ba6a54c58&_e=_MnWvr_TfP0tY9m020QCVKS3VhIeLv3VRWhSIKJ9rgOPrBIFThHixv7rnInIs5PlZw2g7jdCNymJSFQHTLDi_GNyyHhE1ntkskeUPGFlCZ_AYUfh-VNVrcx_8_xiQ9lfLZZWbEbGMEsRTw5qifRsD2o42o5EBSS0p9IL49Qjvtw7QITdD3COth3HiI3oJnaLkzhPOTW6PYeadoSCUQCsTv8DKwDaEqDy7n3TQCfDtlsD5gkZfEwRUR1SPc24XPEZu_TLBjY1hv6m5M1P8WwkUksmyuHpLu9wq_G0Mi6-UJCTcpafUwpBYAQFQJPuWsgNvQj9-yJXb0GL9-1LUlUDwAoxd8DTjPTWRJh7sR5vFQS4a48XKsck-DxKyv7RjlmDZPjPfdA_9kAwzExtRE0HJVvk4KESd7QNM66LgMZxZB4j_yu2KjiF6TaUKHifta_L)
**Bob Casey is completely OUT OF TOUCH.** But, that's what we've come to expect from career politicians like Casey who have spent 18 years in Washington, and it's why the polls show us closing the gap in what will be one of the most competitive Senate races this year.

Will you stand with me and add your name to our petition to _**[SAVE WOMEN'S SPORTS?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=61d6c63bc2564390b0cb058ba6a54c58&_e=_MnWvr_TfP0tY9m020QCVKS3VhIeLv3VRWhSIKJ9rgOPrBIFThHixv7rnInIs5PlZw2g7jdCNymJSFQHTLDi_GNyyHhE1ntkskeUPGFlCZ_AYUfh-VNVrcx_8_xiQ9lfLZZWbEbGMEsRTw5qifRsD2o42o5EBSS0p9IL49Qjvtw7QITdD3COth3HiI3oJnaLkzhPOTW6PYeadoSCUQCsTv8DKwDaEqDy7n3TQCfDtlsD5gkZfEwRUR1SPc24XPEZu_TLBjY1hv6m5M1P8WwkUp9uWuUskwLIdTYgfmlenBDgn5Nf9895Ic6Zv9Fzes0PsQIlPgjI9orgWv8szW5WZWtlcslmvD4EosDwgOLqsGK6dVc3VF4KCw8XM3ilrcQmboEXdRlH2FebSCrMil1UPLOerBw9prx7LTKijioPBXYzCpB2csATsqwmzyG_V9gx)**_
[SAVE WOMEN'S SPORTS: SIGN THE PETITION!](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=61d6c63bc2564390b0cb058ba6a54c58&_e=_MnWvr_TfP0tY9m020QCVKS3VhIeLv3VRWhSIKJ9rgOPrBIFThHixv7rnInIs5PlZw2g7jdCNymJSFQHTLDi_GNyyHhE1ntkskeUPGFlCZ_AYUfh-VNVrcx_8_xiQ9lfLZZWbEbGMEsRTw5qifRsD2o42o5EBSS0p9IL49Qjvtw7QITdD3COth3HiI3oJnaLkzhPOTW6PYeadoSCUQCsTv8DKwDaEqDy7n3TQCfDtlsD5gkZfEwRUR1SPc24XPEZu_TLBjY1hv6m5M1P8WwkUp7Hq9Xc73X89YM-AEEUOQI9YuMeK8yNjxlR-HrwAQ249AlwIdndGAk2WoMu_MPg-PNhNNJFIGttrYxvVAECYhJB4ZbV96q_weKXgWuBJBm6YMg7yU5dE-L6-bmhzx9-HqXcKwuPnqJTybbLXZHatyDqilcG3VDcOiOGHkbLovMg)

**Some things are just basic right vs. wrong.** Boys and girls have biological differences. But Bob Casey _believes the advantage biological boys have when competing against biological girls is "overgeneralized" and "unfounded." _

I may not be a medical professional, but I don't think it's an overgeneralization to state that boys are different from girls. If we let politicians like Bob Casey get reelected, we risk losing women's sports forever.

Two years ago, Pennsylvania was ground zero in the fight to save women's sports. The fight is NOT OVER. We have an opportunity to defeat Casey and flip the Senate majority, but it's going to be a tough fight. **I 'm no stranger to tough fights - from my days as a West Point cadet to the battlefield in Iraq, I've learned the fight for America's future will take every one of us stepping up to do what we can. **

**I 'm a believer in the power of grassroots support, so I'm asking you to step up TODAY to [sign the petition to save women's sports.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=61d6c63bc2564390b0cb058ba6a54c58&_e=_MnWvr_TfP0tY9m020QCVKS3VhIeLv3VRWhSIKJ9rgOPrBIFThHixv7rnInIs5PlZw2g7jdCNymJSFQHTLDi_GNyyHhE1ntkskeUPGFlCZ_AYUfh-VNVrcx_8_xiQ9lfLZZWbEbGMEsRTw5qifRsD2o42o5EBSS0p9IL49Qjvtw7QITdD3COth3HiI3oJnaLkzhPOTW6PYeadoSCUQCsTv8DKwDaEqDy7n3TQCfDtlsD5gkZfEwRUR1SPc24XPEZu_TLBjY1hv6m5M1P8WwkUsJrZTgxqWGcic2lwINRSCVkA06MVAM80jqbA9rPSPZx-D4r4-xmDbzTjQObCSWn5j7RJugTDmUnJCwu_JuPzxUIrZgmFqnxuBNhMODqPqac6_YBY1_ofIHgMIWd8IDPUYrYh6ifJjjQHNc45rhLw4UEt_EMCWJrffMEUVSs19k0)** After adding your name, you'll have an opportunity to pitch in to help me defeat Bob Casey. _If you are able to, I 'm asking you to please chip in $15, $25, $50, or more to help me win this battleground Senate race in Pennsylvania. _
Your support is fueling our campaign as we head into the summer. We're making ground and closing the polling gap by showing voters who Bob Casey REALLY is. I'm so grateful for your support in this fight.

Thank you,

Dave McCormick

name: Governor Greg Abbott
subject: Get to know me.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEXANS FOR GREG ABBOTT
body:
This will only take a few minutes
---
| | | | | | | Untitled Document [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=afa13d2577da4b7ea551e0f59945b87d&_e=sF1DsPKp7eW8qlJIIFdDK4KrC5YKR2WXcoTArSoQKBzV7Ly6PgBX0AS7tq-g9K4ZyrheCeX3fPUS16OHOsPlfTh3zjwgDTaUOzAgpHQ4lmMRI2FDtjtdFiJKOjCUl1ZSW81dlw4LQVNtuX77fkdnjj0Op78Uyps2F8XD9X6-eA9KOGNQC9HRwEELX6KpZc3-lR4Q-L-N_qBOKt_xLPowHHjwOe3bFOMv1AS8zOPRfKJWwjPmrt5StPbv_gItuWz71KJVWgDVTZ2fuGuVv88WGyBlEVgQLRndPpONT6Fg4B8lIRUICS-s91Q3kFay7LGtXUbJPtczERl_J035J0nnLgAbP3GbM4algbon_fLA5GmP_j8BbCH8RD9IY9e7L1IbAyBuj8SsojP4MMR1uK3IfQ%3D%3D)
Fellow Patriot,

_Do you have a few minutes?_

I wanted to take a moment and personally share my story with a true patriot like you.

This is Greg Abbott here, Governor of the great state of Texas.

I was born in Wichita Falls, Texas, and was raised in Duncanville. Growing up, I was involved in various activities, including baseball, Boy Scouts, and track and field.
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=afa13d2577da4b7ea551e0f59945b87d&_e=sF1DsPKp7eW8qlJIIFdDK4KrC5YKR2WXcoTArSoQKBzV7Ly6PgBX0AS7tq-g9K4ZyrheCeX3fPUS16OHOsPlfTh3zjwgDTaUOzAgpHQ4lmMRI2FDtjtdFiJKOjCUl1ZSW81dlw4LQVNtuX77fkdnjj0Op78Uyps2F8XD9X6-eA9KOGNQC9HRwEELX6KpZc3-lR4Q-L-N_qBOKt_xLPowHHjwOe3bFOMv1AS8zOPRfKJWwjPmrt5StPbv_gItuWz7vtimSL5NfPQGqG78NXI8uGM_8NMXJHYUCx4idUwPF2oTnaHTdKHyp8O3M2SMFsHkDBMF9swBcTInKn7hwu1mBpLYiLm_mFRKSHgBiXRY1sxcgW3NfNzdHDENj6HQssXCGr5mLm5HzpopxFsRIjZDFw%3D%3D)
Education has always been very important to me, so I decided to further my education after high school. I went on to attend the University of Texas at Austin and graduated with a B.B.A. in finance. Later on, I earned a law degree from Vanderbilt University.

In 1981, I proposed to the love of my life, Cecilia, on the San Antonio Riverwalk, and we got married later that year. It was the best decision I've ever made!
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=afa13d2577da4b7ea551e0f59945b87d&_e=sF1DsPKp7eW8qlJIIFdDK4KrC5YKR2WXcoTArSoQKBzV7Ly6PgBX0AS7tq-g9K4ZyrheCeX3fPUS16OHOsPlfTh3zjwgDTaUOzAgpHQ4lmMRI2FDtjtdFiJKOjCUl1ZSW81dlw4LQVNtuX77fkdnjj0Op78Uyps2F8XD9X6-eA9KOGNQC9HRwEELX6KpZc3-lR4Q-L-N_qBOKt_xLPowHHjwOe3bFOMv1AS8zOPRfKJWwjPmrt5StPbv_gItuWz7DnlitI-cS1pGo7NQ-nHcB9dF2LL_yOixDYTbL6tiYwAH-r9I-oWl31iYep5zU0bZwZn3EDXvboH7mh3u0zDcmSJDTHHJWDooWDYCvNCs4AVt8AMyzHCa67LCtTqLOOLBY5w6wOiv00OXDa5Sn7Be2A%3D%3D)
Fellow Patriot, everything changed in 1984. One day while I was out jogging, a tree fell on me and left me partially paralyzed. From that moment on, I knew my life would never be the same.
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=afa13d2577da4b7ea551e0f59945b87d&_e=sF1DsPKp7eW8qlJIIFdDK4KrC5YKR2WXcoTArSoQKBzV7Ly6PgBX0AS7tq-g9K4ZyrheCeX3fPUS16OHOsPlfTh3zjwgDTaUOzAgpHQ4lmMRI2FDtjtdFiJKOjCUl1ZSW81dlw4LQVNtuX77fkdnjj0Op78Uyps2F8XD9X6-eA9KOGNQC9HRwEELX6KpZc3-lR4Q-L-N_qBOKt_xLPowHHjwOe3bFOMv1AS8zOPRfKJWwjPmrt5StPbv_gItuWz72vmt0tSU2tS1SJI8nPTRi8DNEzWQZFvQ_TFnoCskxmX1fDN-FMa_CQXMTm8CZ9uR2WDvwdhkEyqFWoaIoUTgAL1Otz8CYoYYvOPTwXLNmPKTKja5PUBk8cJjMkApQxScZ55T2YrGA0ZSIVynEI7Ujw%3D%3D)
From my faith and my family, I gained strength during this difficult time. I learned to recognize that our lives are not defined by our challenges but by how we respond to them. _And I chose not to let this accident break my spirit._

Instead, I turned to the Scripture passage _James 1:12_ , which got me through the most difficult season of my life. I had faith in God and trusted in his plan for me.
_**" Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life, which God has promised to those who love him."
\- James 1:12**_
_Fellow Patriot, during challenging moments in our lives, it 's important to remember what matters the most to us_. For me, it's my faith, my beautiful wife Cecilia, my amazing daughter Audrey, and of course, our three dogs, Peaches, Pancake, and Honey Butter Chicken Biscuit!
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=afa13d2577da4b7ea551e0f59945b87d&_e=sF1DsPKp7eW8qlJIIFdDK4KrC5YKR2WXcoTArSoQKBzV7Ly6PgBX0AS7tq-g9K4ZyrheCeX3fPUS16OHOsPlfTh3zjwgDTaUOzAgpHQ4lmMRI2FDtjtdFiJKOjCUl1ZSW81dlw4LQVNtuX77fkdnjj0Op78Uyps2F8XD9X6-eA9KOGNQC9HRwEELX6KpZc3-lR4Q-L-N_qBOKt_xLPowHHjwOe3bFOMv1AS8zOPRfKJWwjPmrt5StPbv_gItuWz7JFba1iMATXC1_J1MfNhc77slpUxxdotaXlJT88v6jvZHkSAa20XFuaE3jrT3e819R7CTVmlKK6vV2edu87iovP0kXrrFhfpL9UTwgPAoTqd2wvjFjpEk9w1WfXS9WYTWy6yYKXankjunlaFVU-DHFQ%3D%3D)
I often say our lives are not defined by the obstacles we encounter but our response to those challenges. _This rings true for our state and its people, too. _

Under Joe Biden's administration, Texas and all of America face unprecedented challenges daily.
_**[Our southern border is overrun with dangerous criminals.

Our economy is sinking under skyrocketing inflation.

Parents are being denied school choice and freedom.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=afa13d2577da4b7ea551e0f59945b87d&_e=sF1DsPKp7eW8qlJIIFdDK4KrC5YKR2WXcoTArSoQKBzV7Ly6PgBX0AS7tq-g9K4ZyrheCeX3fPUS16OHOsPlfTh3zjwgDTaUOzAgpHQ4lmMRI2FDtjtdFiJKOjCUl1ZSW81dlw4LQVNtuX77fkdnjj0Op78Uyps2F8XD9X6-eA9KOGNQC9HRwEELX6KpZc3-lR4Q-L-N_qBOKt_xLPowHHjwOe3bFOMv1AS8zOPRfKJWwjPmrt5StPbv_gItuWz7-ZSu63goZ3eeJ_S2FMm1wQ2bxNEuPFtuWwca9yL3krFtnJE7dvE1PQ9YkEIXYB0eq4x4rDx_R6P_owQJzrA7nu3GgmRabonB0krpYAjc76-VgM_Cd38WDgjS6NO_M72Sz9RswxwFAj5nMOK4Ca_GkA%3D%3D)**_

clean_body: This will only take a few minutes | | | | | | | Untitled Document Fellow Patriot, Do you have a few minutes? I wanted to take a moment and personally share my story with a true patriot like you. This is Greg Abbott here, Governor of the great state of Texas. I was born in Wichita Falls, Texas, and was raised in Duncanville. Growing up, I was involved in various activities, including baseball, Boy Scouts, and track and field. Education has always been very important to me, so I decided to further my education after high school. I went on to attend the University of Texas at Austin and graduated with a B.B.A. in finance. Later on, I earned a law degree from Vanderbilt University. In 1981, I proposed to the love of my life, Cecilia, on the San Antonio Riverwalk, and we got married later that year. It was the best decision I've ever made! Fellow Patriot, everything changed in 1984. One day while I was out jogging, a tree fell on me and left me partially paralyzed. From that moment on, I knew my life would never be the same. From my faith and my family, I gained strength during this difficult time. I learned to recognize that our lives are not defined by our challenges but by how we respond to them. And I chose not to let this accident break my spirit. Instead, I turned to the Scripture passage James 1:12 , which got me through the most difficult season of my life. I had faith in God and trusted in his plan for me. " Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life, which God has promised to those who love him." \- James 1:12 Fellow Patriot, during challenging moments in our lives, it 's important to remember what matters the most to us. For me, it's my faith, my beautiful wife Cecilia, my amazing daughter Audrey, and of course, our three dogs, Peaches, Pancake, and Honey Butter Chicken Biscuit! I often say our lives are not defined by the obstacles we encounter but our response to those challenges. This rings true for our state and its people, too. Under Joe Biden's administration, Texas and all of America face unprecedented challenges daily. Fellow Patriot, mark my words: I remain steadfast in my focus to build the Texas of tomorrow by making it brighter, safer, freer, and more prosperous. name: Mark Kelly & Ruben Gallego
subject: An important message from Mark and Ruben
body:
#

| | | | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
| Hey everybody, Mark Kelly here.Mark Kelly
And Ruben Gallego.Ruben Gallego |
| In 2020 and 2022, we shared incredible victories in Arizona.Mark Kelly
And we need your help to win again in 2024.Ruben Gallego |
| I need Ruben with me in the Senate. There's no denying that. But we also have to send a message that candidates like Kari Lake have no place there.Mark Kelly
That's right. We were both at the Capitol on January 6th, and Kari Lake still spreads the lies and conspiracies that led to that terrible day in the first place.Ruben Gallego |
| Exactly — and we both put on our country's uniform to serve. We both swore an oath to defend the Constitution. Mark Kelly
We took that oath seriously.Ruben Gallego |
| To defend our democracy and continue delivering for the people of Arizona, we've got to elect Ruben to the U.S. Senate this year. But he can't do that alone.Mark Kelly
Millions of dollars in attack ads are pouring into Arizona as we speak, and we need to raise a ton of resources to fight back.Ruben Gallego |
| That's why we're coming to you today. To ask for help.Mark Kelly
Because I've got an official FEC deadline coming up on June 30th, and we're behind on our goals.Ruben Gallego |
| [Can you please use this link to make a $5 contribution to Ruben's campaign for U.S. Senate? Do it before that FEC deadline, because afterwards he's legally required to report his fundraising numbers. Everybody will be watching to see how Ruben does. ](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240622-1-160&t=1&akid=2503%2E734936%2EsMu83U)Mark Kelly
Even just a few bucks ads up fast when a ton of people chip in together. Ruben Gallego |
| But not everyone can donate.Mark Kelly
That's why it's so important that you do, if you can. Ruben Gallego | [CONTRIBUTE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240622-1-160&t=2&akid=2503%2E734936%2EsMu83U)
* * *
Thanks for your help — really. It means a lot. – Mark Kelly & Ruben Gallego –

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Emails like this are a critical tool for our campaign's fundraising and organizing efforts. name: The Office of Delegate Briana D. Sewell
subject: Del. Sewell's June 22nd Newsletter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Briana Sewell
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/New%20Sewell%20Delegate%20Logo%20.png]
June 22nd Newsletter
Dear neighbors,
Summer is officially here! I don’t know about you, but I feel as though summer began at least a week ago due to the heat. Like last week, this week has been very busy. We had the Dual Congressional District (CD) Primaries for Virginia CD 7 and CD 10. I hope you took the time to vote as it is your right to do so. Please see Election Updates below for the results.
I was grateful to celebrate Juneteenth with our wonderful Prince William County community. Juneteenth, or June 19th, is a holiday observing the emancipation of enslaved people in the United States. Many believe that the end of slavery in the United States came with the Emancipation Proclamation in 1863, however, many enslaved people in the Confederate controlled states did not experience freedom until years later. The last enslaved people in the United States were freed on June 19, 1865, when 2,000-plus Union troops arrived in Galveston Bay, Texas. This day came to be known as "Juneteenth," by the newly freed people in Texas. You can learn more about this holiday and its history on the website of the National Museum of African American History and Culture here [https://nmaahc.si.edu/explore/stories/historical-legacy-juneteenth] . Though the origins of Juneteenth date back to the end of the civil war, the holiday has only reached national and state recognition after national racial justice reckonings in recent years. I was proud to support the creation of Juneteenth as a state holiday and hope that you and your family found a way to acknowledge this significant anniversary.
Town Hall
Please join me and other elected officials from Prince William County for a Town Hall, hosted by Delegate Rozia Henson of Virginia’s 19th District and state Senator Jennifer Carroll Foy of Virginia’s 33rd District, and myself in the Virginia 25th District, on June 27th from 7- 8pm at Occoquan Elementary School. This town hall will include a special focus on environmental concerns in the eastern – end of Prince William County. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/Screenshot%202024-06-20%20at%2012.01.43%20PM.png]
Election Updates
It’s been a pleasure to be out and about in the community as a Democratic candidate for the 7th Congressional District the last few months. Although my congressional campaign did not end as I hoped, I am very proud of the race that I ran and grateful for the support of many who call the 25th District home. I am proud to still be your Delegate in the Virginia General Assembly, and I take that role extremely seriously. If you voted on Tuesday, thank you for doing your civic duty, and make sure you mark Tuesday, November 5th, on your calendar for this coming fall as we will be voting in Prince William County for our representatives in Congress and in the White House.
Virginia’s 7th Congressional District: This seat is currently held by Representative Spanberger who is not running for reelection. The district encompasses the eastern end of Prince William County. Below, please find the names of the respective party nominees from the June 18th primary election.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/Screenshot%202024-06-21%20at%205.04.36%20PM.png] Democratic Primary
Eugene Vindman - (Democratic Nominee)
Republican Primary
Derrick Anderson - (Republican Nominee)
Virginia’s 10th Congressional District: This seat is currently held by Representative Wexton who is not running for re-election due to a debilitating diagnosis. The district encompasses the Western end of Prince William County. Below, please find the names of the respective party nominees from the June 18th primary election.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/Screenshot%202024-06-21%20at%209.47.08%20AM.png] Democratic Primary
Suhas Subramanyam - (Democratic Nominee)
Republican Primary
Mike Clancy - (Republican Nominee)
General Assembly Updates
The Senate of Virginia reconvened on June 18th to discuss the changes made to the Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program (VMSDEP) program under the 2024-2026 biennial budget passed in May. You can view the video of the discussion by the Senate on the streaming website here [https://virginia-senate.granicus.com/MediaPlayer.php?view_id=3&clip_id=6810] . Although the Senate did not take action on any legislation on the day of their special session, you can view the text of the bill that they planned to consider on the Legislative Information System here [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?242+sum+SB6006] .
The Virginia House of Delegates will reconvene on Friday, June 28th, to make a full repeal of the changes made in the 2024-2026 budget and allow time to study the impact of changes to the VMSDEP program in order to take public input on changes. You can view the House’s VMSDEP changes bill here [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?242+sum+HB6003] . You will notice the House has taken a full repeal approach while the Senate has targeted specific changes to roll back.
Issue of the Week - Towing
Continuing on our theme of transportation subcommittees, this week, our subcommittee of the week is the Transportation Innovations Subcommittee. This subcommittee is an ad hoc committee, meaning it only meets on the call of the chair of the subcommittee, Delegate Jackie Glass.
In this year’s Transportation Innovations subcommittee, almost all of the bills heard dealt with one of two issues, speed cameras or towing. There was a large push in the General Assembly this year to strengthen legislation protecting citizens against predatory towers. In this vein, Senate Bill 66 prohibits towing and recovery operators from requiring an individual who appears to retrieve their vehicle to show any document in addition to those already required by law so that they cannot intentionally slow towed vehicle recovery to increase profits. SB 94 makes it a misdemeanor for tow companies to track down accidents to unfairly solicit services or pressure those in need of towing services to use their business, while HB 1073 prohibits tow truck drivers from driving by the scene of a wrecked or disabled vehicle for which a law-enforcement tow has been initiated by a law-enforcement agency. SB 261 allows people whose cars were stolen to remove their vehicle from a towing facility without paying towing and storage fees if they can provide the police report showing their vehicle was reported stolen. Finally, HB 925 requires a towing operator for a parking lot of a multifamily dwelling unit to post written notice on a vehicle providing at least 48 hours' notice prior to towing or be required to reimburse the cost of the tow.
A few bills also dealt with local authority to regulate towers especially in Planning District 8 (Northern Virginia) where previous legislation had set different standards for localities ability to regulate towers. HB1287 allows localities in Planning District 8 to pass ordinances related to towers who tow and store within the same locality and HB 959 allows localities in Planning Districts 8 and 16 to require written authorization of the owner of the property from which the vehicle is towed at the time the vehicle is being towed and regulate the monitoring practices that may be used by towing and recovery operators. That’s all for towing legislation from this year’s General Assembly session!
News You Can Use
Virginia Senate set to take up military tuition program, skill games [https://virginiamercury.com/2024/06/18/virginia-senate-set-to-take-up-military-tuition-program-skill-games/] | Virginia Mercury
Uncertainty reigns as General Assembly makes rare June return
New Virginia laws taking effect July 2024 [https://www.wric.com/news/virginia-news/new-virginia-laws-taking-effect-july-2024/] | ABC News 8
It’s almost July, so you know what that means in Virginia: new state laws to learn. Most of the bills the Virginia General Assembly passes during its annual legislative session that the governor signs take effect July 1 of that year.
State lawmakers to consider skill games legislation [https://www.wdbj7.com/2024/06/17/state-lawmakers-consider-skill-games-legislation/] | WDBJ
Members of the Virginia Senate are returning to Richmond Tuesday. They are revisiting controversial changes to a program that helps some military families pay for higher education. But that’s not all that’s on the agenda. Lawmakers have also introduced two bills that would authorize skill games to operate legally in the Commonwealth once again.
Virginia Senate reconvenes to take up military tuition but fails to act [https://www.washingtonpost.com/dc-md-va/2024/06/18/virginia-senate-military-tuition-youngkin/] | Washington Post
Senators returned to Richmond on Tuesday to consider restoring a tuition waiver program for families of military veterans that was cut back in the state’s budget this year.
State community health workers receive hard-fought budget funding [https://www.vpm.org/news/2024-06-17/virginia-community-health-workers-funding-health-department] | VPM
Community health workers employed by local health departments won funding in Virginia’s newly signed fiscal 2025 and 2026 budget. Bipartisan legislation that would have allowed some CHWs’ work to be reimbursed by Medicaid failed.

June 26 | A Community Dialogue - Living in a Diverse Community: Issues and Concerns [https://www.pwcva.gov/events/community-dialogue-living-diverse-community-issues-and-concerns]
Join a community dialogue hosted by the Prince William County Human Rights Commission in collaboration with the Muslim Association of Virginia (Dar Alnoor Islamic Community Center).
June 27 | Guitar Sing-Along [https://pwcgov.libnet.info/event/10657771]
Join Jerry and Chet for a fun musical program to sing along to at the Dumfries Library.

Learn from the Prince William County Police Department about how you can protect your community.
July 10 | Planning Commission Meeting [https://www.pwcva.gov/events/planning-commission-meeting-july-10-2024]

State and Community Info & Resources
How much do you know about our local court system? In Prince William County the 31st Judicial Circuit Court has general trial court jurisdiction, including acting as an appellate court for the General District and Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts, and is a separate and distinct branch of government. The Circuit Court presides over criminal, civil, concealed handgun permits, miscellaneous, and other cases. The 31st Judicial Circuit currently has seven full-time judges.
Jury Duty: One of our civic duties as residents of Prince William County is serving on jury duty when we are called. If you are called to jury duty you will receive a summons in the mail. Make sure you respond promptly and accurately as failure to do so can get you in trouble with the law. Learn more about jury duty in Prince William County here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/circuit-court/jury-duty] .

According to the Juvenile & Domestic Relations Court website, to begin a child custody, visitation, or support case, the person seeking a petition should contact the local court services unit intake office at the following address/telephone number to schedule an appointment. An intake officer will assist you in the preparation of petitions. Learn more on the website here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/juvenile-domestic-relations-court/child-support-faqs] .

clean_body: [] June 22nd Newsletter Dear neighbors, Summer is officially here! I don’t know about you, but I feel as though summer began at least a week ago due to the heat. Like last week, this week has been very busy. We had the Dual Congressional District (CD) Primaries for Virginia CD 7 and CD 10. I hope you took the time to vote as it is your right to do so. Please see Election Updates below for the results. I was grateful to celebrate Juneteenth with our wonderful Prince William County community. Juneteenth, or June 19th, is a holiday observing the emancipation of enslaved people in the United States. Many believe that the end of slavery in the United States came with the Emancipation Proclamation in 1863, however, many enslaved people in the Confederate controlled states did not experience freedom until years later. The last enslaved people in the United States were freed on June 19, 1865, when 2,000-plus Union troops arrived in Galveston Bay, Texas. This day came to be known as "Juneteenth," by the newly freed people in Texas. You can learn more about this holiday and its history on the website of the National Museum of African American History and Culture here [] . Though the origins of Juneteenth date back to the end of the civil war, the holiday has only reached national and state recognition after national racial justice reckonings in recent years. I was proud to support the creation of Juneteenth as a state holiday and hope that you and your family found a way to acknowledge this significant anniversary. Town Hall Please join me and other elected officials from Prince William County for a Town Hall, hosted by Delegate Rozia Henson of Virginia’s 19th District and state Senator Jennifer Carroll Foy of Virginia’s 33rd District, and myself in the Virginia 25th District, on June 27th from 7- 8pm at Occoquan Elementary School. This town hall will include a special focus on environmental concerns in the eastern – end of Prince William County. [] Election Updates It’s been a pleasure to be out and about in the community as a Democratic candidate for the 7th Congressional District the last few months. Although my congressional campaign did not end as I hoped, I am very proud of the race that I ran and grateful for the support of many who call the 25th District home. I am proud to still be your Delegate in the Virginia General Assembly, and I take that role extremely seriously. If you voted on Tuesday, thank you for doing your civic duty, and make sure you mark Tuesday, November 5th, on your calendar for this coming fall as we will be voting in Prince William County for our representatives in Congress and in the White House. The district encompasses the Western end of Prince William County. Below, please find the names of the respective party nominees from the June 18th primary election. [] Democratic Primary Suhas Subramanyam - (Democratic Nominee) Republican Primary Mike Clancy - (Republican Nominee) General Assembly Updates The Senate of Virginia reconvened on June 18th to discuss the changes made to the Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program (VMSDEP) program under the 2024-2026 biennial budget passed in May. You can view the video of the discussion by the Senate on the streaming website here [] . Although the Senate did not take action on any legislation on the day of their special session, you can view the text of the bill that they planned to consider on the Legislative Information System here [] . The Virginia House of Delegates will reconvene on Friday, June 28th, to make a full repeal of the changes made in the 2024-2026 budget and allow time to study the impact of changes to the VMSDEP program in order to take public input on changes. You can view the House’s VMSDEP changes bill here [] . You will notice the House has taken a full repeal approach while the Senate has targeted specific changes to roll back. Issue of the Week - Towing Continuing on our theme of transportation subcommittees, this week, our subcommittee of the week is the Transportation Innovations Subcommittee. This subcommittee is an ad hoc committee, meaning it only meets on the call of the chair of the subcommittee, Delegate Jackie Glass. In this year’s Transportation Innovations subcommittee, almost all of the bills heard dealt with one of two issues, speed cameras or towing. There was a large push in the General Assembly this year to strengthen legislation protecting citizens against predatory towers. In this vein, Senate Bill 66 prohibits towing and recovery operators from requiring an individual who appears to retrieve their vehicle to show any document in addition to those already required by law so that they cannot intentionally slow towed vehicle recovery to increase profits. SB 94 makes it a misdemeanor for tow companies to track down accidents to unfairly solicit services or pressure those in need of towing services to use their business, while HB 1073 prohibits tow truck drivers from driving by the scene of a wrecked or disabled vehicle for which a law-enforcement tow has been initiated by a law-enforcement agency. SB 261 allows people whose cars were stolen to remove their vehicle from a towing facility without paying towing and storage fees if they can provide the police report showing their vehicle was reported stolen. Finally, HB 925 requires a towing operator for a parking lot of a multifamily dwelling unit to post written notice on a vehicle providing at least 48 hours' notice prior to towing or be required to reimburse the cost of the tow. A few bills also dealt with local authority to regulate towers especially in Planning District 8 (Northern Virginia) where previous legislation had set different standards for localities ability to regulate towers. name: Sarah McBride
subject: Happy Pride Month! 🏳️‍🌈
body:
I’ve always said that I’m not running for Congress to make history, I’m running to make a difference.
#
Happy Pride Month, team!
I’ve always said that I’m not running for Congress to make history, **I’m running to make a difference**. But as we enter Pride Month, I have been reflecting a little bit about what it would mean to be the first openly trans member of Congress and the importance of this race for young LGBTQ+ people who deserve to see themselves in government, too.
Truthfully, it’s only fair that when issues directly impacting trans folks are being discussed, trans people have a seat – _at least_ one – at the table. I’m humbled at the thought that I may be the first to hold a seat in Congress, **but I’m absolutely sure I won’t be the last.**
From the start of this campaign, I’ve also said I don’t want to be known just for my identity. I want to be known as an effective member of Congress working on _all_ of the issues that matter to _everyone_. And that _includes_ our LGBTQ+ neighbors.
**So yes, I’ll absolutely be fighting to protect and secure the rights of LGBTQ+ people all over the country.**
But LGBTQ+ people care about things like health care, the economy, paid family and medical leave, and raising the minimum wage as well — and I’ll be fighting just as hard to improve life for _everyone_ on those fronts, too.
[**So team, if you’re ready to help me get to work in Congress, will you pitch in $5 to help power my campaign today? I can’t do it without you!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240622-1?refcode=em20240622-1&amount=5&refcode2=669_21716_ZgolAt&akid=669%2E21716%2EZgolAt)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240622-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240622-1-669&refcode2=669_21716_ZgolAt&akid=669%2E21716%2EZgolAt)**
Thank you, team. And I hope you have a wonderful Pride Month!
Sarah McBride

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87379518/480955642/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ3ZDNkN2NkLWExMzAtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2MmWpHKYJYb1VDhv5Gl0cdAvsFZ8lMmm04Dm3_yrNuM=&emci=194813ea-0a30-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=47d3d7cd-a130-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8431045)

We’ve got to be honest, Peter: When we dug into the Supreme Court ruling in _Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP_ — the case that upheld the state’s brazen racial gerrymander — we were shocked. **That's because the ruling rolls out the red carpet for gerrymandering.** The Court’s decision to uphold racial gerrymandering is _exactly_ why we need to keep the fight for fair maps — and the NDRC — going strong. [**Can you rush a donation to fuel our important work so we can continue to push back against attacks on our democracy?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87379519/480955643/1762736337?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_junefun_email_20240622-NDRC-Tier1-SouthCarolina_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240622-NDRC-Tier1-SouthCarolina_&utm_campaign=junefun&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ3ZDNkN2NkLWExMzAtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2MmWpHKYJYb1VDhv5Gl0cdAvsFZ8lMmm04Dm3_yrNuM=) Now, allow us, if you will, to get into some of the “meat and potatoes” of these opinions in _Alexander_. Samuel Alito’s majority opinion cited research on voter turnout by race — but the organization that actually _did_ that research, the Brennan Center, later pointed out that he drew the completely wrong conclusion from it. And Clarence Thomas’ concurrence was, unsurprisingly, even more dangerously radical than the ruling. He said federal courts shouldn’t play ANY role in stopping racial gerrymandering, and he even argued that the judiciary had set bad precedents on this front by enforcing school desegregation after _Brown v. Board_ opinion.... MAKE IT MAKE SENSE! **Reading in between the lines, the ruling is part of an ongoing assault on voting rights and our democracy. Now it’s _our_ job to balance the scales — so racial gerrymandering can’t silence voters of color and map manipulators can’t tilt elections in their favor. ** [**It’s time for us to ramp up our efforts like never before. So if you’re mad as hell like we are, join us in making a grassroots donation to the NDRC today.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87379520/480955644/1762736337?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_junefun_email_20240622-NDRC-Tier1-SouthCarolina_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240622-NDRC-Tier1-SouthCarolina_&utm_campaign=junefun&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ3ZDNkN2NkLWExMzAtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2MmWpHKYJYb1VDhv5Gl0cdAvsFZ8lMmm04Dm3_yrNuM=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

clean_body: The Supreme Court’s ruling in South Carolina is part of an ongoing assault on democracy. | We’ve got to be honest, Peter: When we dug into the Supreme Court ruling in Alexander v. South Carolina State Conference of the NAACP — the case that upheld the state’s brazen racial gerrymander — we were shocked. That's because the ruling rolls out the red carpet for gerrymandering. The Court’s decision to uphold racial gerrymandering is exactly why we need to keep the fight for fair maps — and the NDRC — going strong. = Now, allow us, if you will, to get into some of the “meat and potatoes” of these opinions in Alexander. Samuel Alito’s majority opinion cited research on voter turnout by race — but the organization that actually did that research, the Brennan Center, later pointed out that he drew the completely wrong conclusion from it. And Clarence Thomas’ concurrence was, unsurprisingly, even more dangerously radical than the ruling. He said federal courts shouldn’t play ANY role in stopping racial gerrymandering, and he even argued that the judiciary had set bad precedents on this front by enforcing school desegregation after Brown v. Board opinion.... MAKE IT MAKE SENSE! Reading in between the lines, the ruling is part of an ongoing assault on voting rights and our democracy. Now it’s our job to balance the scales — so racial gerrymandering can’t silence voters of color and map manipulators can’t tilt elections in their favor. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Thank you for standing with us — and with democracy. — The NDRC Team = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38930%2E3422442%2E_NVdkY)
Derek, Katie needs your support.
See, private health insurance companies have been using deceptive tactics to promote Medicare Advantage plans that leave patients without the care they need and cheat taxpayers.
Katie Porter is doing something about that — she’s urging the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) to collect more data, improve transparency, and hold insurers accountable.
**[But we need to light a fire under them — they need to feel the pressure that only a grassroots movement like ours can deliver. Will you please add your name today to help millions of Americans get cheaper, better health care?](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/ttp-em-20240622/?source=em20240622-38930&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&akid=38930%2E3422442%2E_NVdkY)**
This is important because some Medicare Advantage plans misreport data to get overpayment from Medicare — which costs us billions of dollars.
Plus, other insurers offer Medicare Advantage supplemental benefits that are purposely hard for consumers to understand. For example, among the 2,400 Medicare Advantage plans that had a hearing aid benefit in 2016, **there were 123 unique variations of coverage.**
With so many choices to navigate, it’s difficult for patients to choose the right plan for their needs.
**[If you agree with those goals, will you please add your name today? The more support we build, the more we can pressure CMS to do the right thing.](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/ttp-em-20240622/?source=em20240622-38930&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&akid=38930%2E3422442%2E_NVdkY)**
Thanks!
-Team Truth to Power
