| From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Dear Fellow Patriot,

We are witnessing a brutal, unceasing, and deadly assault currently being waged against American families--especially the traditional nuclear family. I'm sure you've felt it.

That's why I launched the American Cornerstone Institute--what I call a "think tank / do tank" -- in order to continue this perilous fight to protect, shore up, and support American families. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=08099301b0fc4d2791ff770ab5fd298d&_e=ARcPjfhAmUI8zJ6Vc-beFwDqDqPcI660QOFppKZFmnaIX3L5PKsic3k4_UUS-XaBTKTwT-b3SbatupRtlRrkLaWmQpoziLVn-G31RFQ1fQIzVpD03n1lqrOKvWC6wQXJTHMGmpaBHJ4-s_j5czVCrRQl7xvTcaC-c-n3KnOvxeJ8eHbd93y15JiNfMchH62wb4lYuDbzCcaQQvWuuwS1lsx39rkkTeHRtcH43TOl7BJ7MtYhYtO9JgXQeg4qtTOtVBKTvydSSZasGlmpe8qdW19oWYYhMFlq_MlOaqCLQ6l0TmKsSuFSysB-VfiicVfYREZD7v4XRrr2Cfg0hd-PnLadnbTOGI2_jDV2UbjWwqlmaCSc8hQQDV-EIbuf1rsUySeVr4Y2gd40KgPf3kPaeA%3D%3D) Your gift of $100 or more to ACI today will help strengthen the bonds of our communities by lifting up the virtues of faith, liberty, community, and life.

Will you give today to support these cornerstone principles? They are essential to the success of our nation--principles that can be bolstered immeasurably and immediately by strengthening our families. To show my appreciation for your gift of $100 or more, you will receive an advanced signed copy of my new book "The Perilous Fight: Overcoming Our Culture's War on the American Family".

And to help pass down these important pillars to the next generation, I'lll also send you a free copy of my children's book "Why America Matters" that celebrates our great country and reminds us what a blessing it is to be an American.

You can make your secure gift here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/the-perilous-fight](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=08099301b0fc4d2791ff770ab5fd298d&_e=ARcPjfhAmUI8zJ6Vc-beFwDqDqPcI660QOFppKZFmnaIX3L5PKsic3k4_UUS-XaBTKTwT-b3SbatupRtlRrkLaWmQpoziLVn-G31RFQ1fQIzVpD03n1lqrOKvWC6wQXJTHMGmpaBHJ4-s_j5czVCrRQl7xvTcaC-c-n3KnOvxeJ8eHbd93y15JiNfMchH62wb4lYuDbzCcaQQvWuuwS1lsx39rkkTeHRtcH43TOl7BJ7MtYhYtO9JgXQeg4qtTOt2-V99Ey7gPsl-jTapKV2j14PII05GaNteAnGVki2GudicqKBGYiA_4Iyn-8AxzbxB3IzMiCTzcpJW2enYKKgYf37UDt6H1f7ulbByibhMGfk1jdqhDPBI6xDYOYxt6Q3JWiHlM_zlO0rrekfudXIfQ%3D%3D)

Thank you for your interest in preserving and strengthening America's families!

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want your opinion on religious liberty
body:

American Cornerstone Institute

I am reaching out today because I believe that you, like
me, are concerned
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWq6qsAWNq

Dear Fellow American,

I am reaching out today because I believe that you,
like me, are concerned about the increasing trend of legal
persecution against Americans who wish to live their lives
according to their faith. Our cornerstones of faith, liberty,
community, and life form the bedrock of our great nation, and we
need your help to maintain them.

From a high school football coach in Washington who
lost his job for praying on the field (KENNEDY v. BREMERTON
SCHOOL DISTRICT), to a Colorado baker hauled through the legal
system multiple times for not wanting to bake a cake that
violated his religious convictions (MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v.
COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION), we can't ignore the gradual
erosion of religious freedom in America.

That's why I created the American Cornerstone
Institute to advocate for commonsense solutions to these issues
and to strengthen the bonds that keep our nation united. But we
can't do it alone.

We need your voice.

I want to personally invite you to participate in
this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in
America.

You can share your thoughts using this secure link:
https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/

Your responses are confidential and will be used
solely towards furthering our advocacy efforts.

Please, take a few minutes of your time to complete
the survey. Your input is vital in helping us understand the
scope of these issues and develop impactful strategies to
counteract them.

Your opinion truly matters. Together, we can ensure
that religious liberty continues to thrive as an integral part of
our American society.

For Liberty,

Dr. Ben Carson

Founder and Chairman

American Cornerstone Institute

Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our
mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious
liberty, helping our country's most vulnerable find new hope, and
developing methods to decrease the federal government's role in
society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's
citizens.

All rights reserved.

Friend, Earlier this week, I signed a historic executive order to pardon 175,000 convictions in Maryland related to the possession of cannabis. This includes convictions for misdemeanor possession of cannabis and certain convictions for misdemeanor possession of drug paraphernalia. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87384214/480969136/1379872749?refcode=em20240622-1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YTc0OGMzYy1hODMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mkgPb70d82pEfu0OlcYqBTUCPcJWTSRUuLJPO7fpYSk=) This is the largest pardon in the country — and I am proud to make history right here in our state and lead the way for other states to follow in our step in the right direction. **This order will change the lives of hundreds of thousands of Marylanders.** We made history when we legalized cannabis by referendum. But we cannot celebrate legalization while forgetting the consequences of criminalization. When it comes to cannabis, rolling out one of the best and most equitable legal markets in the country is important, but that rollout must go hand-in-hand with pardoning past conduct. We are taking a big step toward enacting policies that can reverse the harm of the past and help us build a brighter future. We couldn’t have gotten here without the extraordinary partnership of our incredible lawmakers, leaders, and advocates. **[Today, I’m hoping you’ll help us celebrate this historic moment by adding a donation right now to support the work our administration is doing to change the lives of Marylanders. Friend of Life,

My name is Lila Rose, and I'm the founder and president of Live Action.

I'm reaching out with an urgent and heartfelt request. This month, Live Action is partnering with pro-life pregnancy resource centers nationwide to provide onesies for mothers and babies in need. Will you join us for our first-ever onesie drive?

This month only, a gift of $60 will provide three custom "Wonderfully Made" onesies to three moms and their babies at risk of abortion. These onesies are more than just clothing--they are symbols of hope and reminders that every child is a precious gift, beautifully and wonderfully made. [ ](http://trk.secureandprosper.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM4ODM3MTYzNCIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MTc0LTIyYzgxNWQ1MWVmZDQ1ZWI5ZDMzM2QyZGUwZGY1MDcxIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2dpdmUubGl2ZWFjdGlvbi5vcmcvc2VuZC1hLW9uZXNpZS10b2RheS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1vbmVzaWUmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Z2VuZXJpY19BRS1TUE81MDY5NCJ9/T24yMbk90HWJ643E9n7Fpw)
Onesies are a basic necessity for every baby. More than that, they symbolize the love and care each new life needs to thrive--a tangible representation of personal connection and love for both mother and baby. For mothers facing unplanned pregnancies or struggling with financial difficulties, having the basics provided can make all the difference in helping them feel supported.

Every baby is a gift that deserves to be cherished and provided for, and every mother deserves to know her baby is treasured not just by her but also by her community.

Abortion providers like Planned Parenthood rely on women feeling isolated by their unplanned pregnancies. Together, we can show these courageous women they are supported and loved by a community that values every life.

To make this possible, you can donate $60 to send custom onesies to three moms and babies in need. Click here to donate: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-onesie-today/](http://trk.secureandprosper.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM4ODM3MTYzNCIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MTc0LTIyYzgxNWQ1MWVmZDQ1ZWI5ZDMzM2QyZGUwZGY1MDcxIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2dpdmUubGl2ZWFjdGlvbi5vcmcvc2VuZC1hLW9uZXNpZS10b2RheS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1vbmVzaWUmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Z2VuZXJpY19BRS1TUE81MDY5NCJ9/Rzhr4O4LFgVoxeKal-ZsZA)**

If you can, please share this email with friends and family who might also want to help or share our campaign on social media to raise awareness.

Thank you for stepping up to support mothers and their precious children. With your help, we can make a profound difference in these families' lives.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**
Live Action

_P.S. Remember, this campaign only runs until the end of the month! #
I love the summertime, folks — especially back home in Minnesota. But the summer months can be difficult for grassroots fundraising — people are offline, enjoying the nice weather (as they should!), and paying less attention to politics. My record speaks for itself, team. I am disappointed by the Supreme Court’s decision to reverse the ban on bump stocks — essentially allowing the public to own weapons that function as machine guns. The good news is: **I was a cosponsor of SB 5992 that banned bump stocks in Washington, and our bill is still valid even after this Supreme Court ruling.** This shows the importance of having somebody in the Governor’s office who is not beholden to the extreme wings of either party, because our local laws make a difference. I am _the candidate_ with the track record of putting public safety issues first. **In 2018, as a state Senator, I sponsored and voted for the ban on bump stocks.** I'm proud to be the only candidate endorsed by WACops and LAW (Police Chiefs and Sheriffs) because I speak out on public safety every year, not just during campaign season. clean_body: Please take a minute to share your priority issues. Write as little or as much as you like, and our team will do our best to review every response. Emily Randall for Congress | This email was sent to you because needs your help to win in WA-06. But, if you want to hear from us less, you can sign up for or at any time. Peter — I’m running for Congress because all too often, the voices of working people — most of us — aren’t heard in the halls of power. So, today, I’m asking you one question: What issue do you care about most right now? I read about some members of Congress who go months without a single public event. To me, that defeats the purpose of public service! As State Senator, I represent my neighbors. People come up with questions and concerns on the sidewalk, the coffee shop, and the grocery store. In my first term alone, I spoke with thousands of Washingtonians at events and community meetings. My wife, Alison, jokes that since I was elected, it takes twice as long to do errands. But I believe that you can’t represent people if you don’t listen to them. Most of us, regardless of age, background, or ideology, want leaders who are responsive, accessible, and honest — that’s how I run my office as a State Senator and that’s how I will run my office as your member of Congress. But as hard as I try, I can’t speak to every single WA-06 voter in-person. That’s where the online surveys come in. Can you take a minute and let me know what issues you care about most right now? name: Jon Tester & Sherrod Brown
subject: the toughest reelection fight of our lives
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here.
Hi Derek,
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re in the middle of the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country, and we need your help to win.
We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.
**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.
But right now, we’re in the toughest reelection fight of our lives.
**FIRST,** election experts called us the most vulnerable Democratic senators up in 2024.
**THEN,** Mitch McConnell and his cronies said they would spend over a hundred million dollars to try to defeat us.
**NOW,** we’re officially up against two self-funding multimillionaires who are bankrolling their campaigns themselves.
We can’t write our campaigns million dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: You. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers, you name it — who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference.
**[Things are really heating up in our races so we’ve set a rapid response Big Sky Buckeye Fund goal to raise $500,000 in the next 48 hours to fight back against the millions being thrown our way. So we’re asking: Will you chip in $5 to split between our campaigns and John Fetterman to keep a seven-fingered dirt farmer and a disheveled champion for the Dignity of Work in the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240622?refcode=em20240622-9146&refcode2=9146_434096_hBdq4p&akid=9146%2E434096%2EhBdq4p)**

Thanks for having our backs. We won’t let you down.
—Jon Tester & Sherrod Brown

name: Jill Stein
subject: America is sick, and getting sicker.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
A national diagnosis from your family physician, Dr. Stein.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healthcare&n=1)
---
Peter,

Long before I launched my first campaign for office, I served for over two decades as a doctor of Internal Medicine.

In fact, it was my practice as a physician that steered me into full time activism.

As a doctor, I came to understand that the problems most of my patients faced did not stem from lifestyle “choices” or even their family medical history. It was the toxic combination of corporate greed and political corruption, poisoning our planet and our people while forcing all of us into the unsustainable grind of capitalism.

I haven’t been a practicing physician for a number of years – but I can still diagnose our collective affliction.

**_Let’s review some basic facts:_**
---
* **26 million Americans have NO health insurance at all.

**
* **Up to 43% of American adults are UNDER-insured** – meaning that your health insurance doesn’t cover your basic medical expenses.

* **41% (or 73 MILLION) Americans are in debt for medical bills.
****
**
* **At least 68,000 Americans die every year because they can’t access affordable healthcare.**

---
We spend more on healthcare than any other country on earth for the privilege of living sicker and dying younger than ANY of our peer nations.

_But it doesn’t have to be this way.

_**Universal healthcare is fully within our grasp, and it is the only solution to the tangled mess of the privatized American healthcare system that leaves millions falling through the cracks.

** Imagine a world where you don’t have to pay a copay to see a doctor or collect a prescription.

Imagine a world where you don’t have to spend hours on the phone to find out if your preferred doctor is in network – or to get your visit covered if they’re not.

Imagine a world where, when you are sick, you simply go to the doctor – and they treat you.

No deductibles. No co-pays. No mandatory minimums and no lifetime maximums. Just healthcare.

**[That is not a wild fantasy. That is the reality in dozens of countries around the world – and it could be our reality, too. Our campaign is fighting to guarantee no American struggles, suffers, or dies because they can’t get basic healthcare.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healthcare&n=2)**
---
| [](http://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healthcare&n=3 "DONATE") [DONATE](http://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healthcare&n=3)
---
When Democrats like Joe Biden tell you that healthcare is a human right, what they really mean is that healthcare has the right to be profitable for insurance carriers.

My vision for healthcare is radically different – shaped by decades of experience as a physician and a lifetime of activism.

When I am president, we will push Congress to immediately expand and implement a national Medicare for All program that covers every single American from birth.

We will move to cancel ALL medical debt and to codify patients’ rights (including the right to an abortion and all bodily autonomy).

We will restore public trust in government agencies with transparency and effective oversight, and shut the revolving door between regulatory bodies like the FDA and CDC and the multibillion dollar corporations they are supposed to govern.

All of this **[and a whole lot more](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=Qj32F8ZTIcBOzthgR25-gF2J_V8cRlHgwGIBI_1lcLQ0Ce7w_K4rbPSVLguxOifF&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healthcare&n=4)** is attainable.

As your president, my highest responsibility will be the safety and well-being of our people and our planet – not the profits of multinational corporations or the robber barons in the executive suite.

**Ours is the ONLY campaign slated to be on the ballot across the country this November with the credibility and experience to challenge empire and corporate greed to ensure we not only survive, but thrive.

****I need your support to guarantee that every American has the choice to vote for people, planet, and peace.**
---
| [](http://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healthcare&n=5 "DONATE") [DONATE](http://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=healthcare&n=5)
---
Human health has always been inextricably connected with society. It’s a question of what and WHO we choose to invest in.

I choose us.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---

body:
| Hi friend — Here’s something you may not know about me: **I’m gay.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70521?t=6&akid=15206%2E878179%2EWkWNAr) Pride Month is a time when we are supposed to be celebrating the countless qualities that make people beautifully different.

But this year, it’s tough to celebrate when extremist Republicans are doubling down on their hateful bills to target LGBTQ+ people like me.

They’re banning gender-affirming care for trans kids.

They’re targeting drag shows.

They’re silencing discussions about pronouns and LGBTQ+ history in schools.

They’re allowing religious entities to discriminate against LGBTQ+ people.

They’re forcing trans people to use bathrooms that don’t correspond to their gender identity...**and so much more.

**The recent uptick in anti-LGBTQ+ bills is not only heartbreaking; but also illustrates how long of a way we have to go to secure equal rights and protections for LGBTQ+ folks like me. And that starts with voting out every single homophobic, bigoted Republican at the ballot box.**

[The Voter Protection Project is dedicated to replacing these same Republicans with Democrats who are dedicated to guaranteeing equality for _all_ LGBTQ+ people. If you support our mission, will you chip in anything you can in honor of Pride Month to help us continue our work? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70521?t=7&akid=15206%2E878179%2EWkWNAr)** | [CONTRIBUTE $7 NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70521?t=8&akid=15206%2E878179%2EWkWNAr)
---
Here’s what Republicans don’t want you to know: **80% of Americans support anti-discriminatory laws that support LGBTQ+ people.**

_But they’ll suppress the right to vote to ensure they can stay in power so they can keep fueling their anti-LGBTQ+ agenda._

I’m fed up with watching folks in my community be targeted, silenced, and attacked for choosing to live as their authentic selves.

[If you are too, will contribute to the Voter Protection Project today? Every dollar donated to this email will go towards combating Republicans’ attacks on the ballot box while electing Democrats who will push for LGBTQ+ protections. »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70521?t=9&akid=15206%2E878179%2EWkWNAr)

Happy Pride, Peter!
🏳️🌈

When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public
service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between
pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun24.Hijekx&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240622_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=2880%2E35263%2EmIduNU ]Tammy Baldwin

After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by
coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who
they love, I came to realize that I could do both:

I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly
what I did.

When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s
history, (thanks to support from this incredible grassroots team!) I
understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a
difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to
protecting same-sex marriage through the Respect for Marriage Act, I’ve
worked hard every day since to do just that.

That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but
to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted
to make a difference, too.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun24.Hijekx&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240622_AM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=2880%2E35263%2EmIduNU ]This Pride Month, I’m hoping you’ll support this important work by

body:
| | |
---
Friend — I’m a born-and-raised Missourian.
And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390087/480987889/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)
I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. **But if you give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree —[and I hope you’ll then split a donation of any amount to help Lucas Kunce's campaign and Maggie Hassan's to defeat Josh Hawley this November.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390099/480987909/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)**
| | [CHIP IN NOW →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390106/480987924/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)
---
It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not married — just gay.
While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you reading this.
Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be forever indebted to them.
My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just a few months before the _Dobbs_ decision. As any parent with IVF kids can tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails. Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be a right.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390117/480987943/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)
Now, two years after _Dobbs_ , we’re living in an America that has less freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has) that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.
**And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley — who is now up for his first election since everything changed.**
You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work in the _Dobbs_ case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide — **[and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat Hawley in November, then please make that split donation to help him get it done.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390120/480987956/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)**
| | [CHIP IN NOW →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390123/480987960/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)
---
**But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive freedom, then keep reading.**
It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth control for their workers. He even said contraceptives _“may induce an abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg”_ — which, to be clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every medical professional.
Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to overturn _Roe_ , enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal personhood” bills at the national level.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390127/480987963/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)
**Then, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF and our right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee access to IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?**
**Hawley told the media the Right To IVF Act was really part of an “abortion agenda.”**
**I’m sorry, but that’s CRAZY.**
| | [CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390140/480987973/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)
---
His ultimate goal here is obvious — Josh Hawley doesn’t just want Big Brother politicians like himself to control us in our bedrooms and our doctor’s offices. He wants to control OUR bodies, and even how we choose to build and raise OUR families.
And if he gets another six years to finish what he’s started, then the ability to build a family like mine — or even likely a family like yours — could be made impossible.
**Josh Hawley poses a unique and existential threat to reproductive freedom, and this is our one chance to put a stop to his crusade against our freedoms.[We can’t afford to give him another six years in the U.S. Senate — so, I'm asking: Can you please split a donation between Lucas Kunce’s campaign and Maggie Hassan's today so we can secure our freedoms?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87390158/480987989/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2617-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTMzZWI3Ny1iMDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZkVTISdheV_mFg4SubuHMV1d28AaCAcva7DZtT54V0g=)**

subject: We deserve leaders focused on real problems, not fake ones

body:
Just a couple of years ago, Ron DeSantis was strongly in favor of stripping people who are convicted of crimes of their voting rights.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240622-1&t=1&akid=842%2E587540%2ErAQTzE)
This is bullsh*t, Peter.
Just a couple of years ago, Ron DeSantis and Florida Republicans were _strongly_ in favor of stripping people who are convicted of crimes of their voting rights. They even went out of their way to **water down a voter-approved ballot initiative** restoring those rights, ensuring as few people as possible could benefit.
But now that MAGA’s lord and savior Donald Trump has been convicted on all 34 felony counts in his trial in New York, **they’re singing a different tune.** DeSantis now says that the state clemency board (which he chairs) will make sure that Trump gets to vote this November.
**It’s just one more example showing that these guys don’t believe in _anything_ but their own power — and the fake, made-up narratives they spin to maintain it.**
**[If you're ready to elect the kind of leaders we actually deserve, pitch in $5 today and help us elect them all over the country this November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240622-1?refcode=em20240622-1&amount=5&refcode2=842_587540_rAQTzE&akid=842%2E587540%2ErAQTzE)**
While real people are struggling to afford a place to live because housing costs are out of control, _Trump is crying about being “persecuted”_ for being held accountable for committing crimes.
While real kids are at risk of dying of gun violence in their schools and in their homes and communities, Ron DeSantis is doing nothing to help them but _everything_ to cater to Trump’s every whim.
And in Congress, governor’s offices, and state legislatures all over the country, **Republican elected officials at every level of power are going along with it.** It’s shameful — and it’s why we’re working so hard to kick them out of office and replace them with leaders we _actually_ deserve this November and beyond.
We’ve endorsed 12 fantastic young candidates across the country this year. These are young leaders who actually know what it’s like to struggle to make ends meet, who are young enough to have gone through regular active shooter drills in school, and **who will spend their time focused on real problems, not fake ones.**
We invest a LOT in our endorsed candidates, and they often depend heavily on our support to win. But as a grassroots organization that doesn’t take corporate donations, we can’t do it without your support.
**[So Peter, if you're ready to elect the leaders we deserve this November, please pitch in $5 today. Every amount adds up to make a big difference.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240622-1?refcode=em20240622-1&amount=5&refcode2=842_587540_rAQTzE&akid=842%2E587540%2ErAQTzE)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending his lawyers after President Trump and two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Like me, I’m sure you know how important being out on the field is for a campaign – it’s the heartbeat of every successful campaign.
And with a race like Cori’s, we’re getting busier by the minute.
Just this month, we’ve set up regular canvassing, we’ve locked down some dates for endorsement partners, finished training a new team of champion organizers, and we’re working on outreach with several communities here in St. Louis.
And just recently, we hit over 17,000 doors knocked – that’s 17,000 people and families that now know how important it is to keep Cori in Congress! You can fuel our door-knocking by rushing a $10, $25, or $50 donation right now >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_062224_field]
As you can see, our field team is in a good place. All we need now is the resources to keep us going. Because, unfortunately for us, the GOP megadonors pouring money into our race are only making it more difficult for us to reach the people of St. Louis.
There's so many ways you can help us.
$5 buys a pack of pens to sign voter registration cards [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_062224_field&amount=5]

So, friend, will you pitch in $10, $15, or $25 right now to ensure we have the resources necessary to run a winning field program? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_062224_field]

Marquis Govan, Field Director

**June 12, 2016**
At a gay nightclub during Pride
49 dead **June 17, 2015**
In a church during a Bible study group
9 dead **Dec 14, 2012**
A grade school in Connecticut
26 dead
_This month, the first-grade survivors are graduating from high school._ I've been reflecting on these anniversaries a lot this month. During my time in the Army, I ran willingly into gunfire and had friends of mine killed by assault weapons on the battlefield. No one should experience that in American neighborhoods. It makes me all the more disgusted by Brian Fitzpatrick's actions to single-handedly block commonsense gun legislation last year. Serving in combat? That takes courage. Voting "yes" for universal background checks and an assault weapons ban? Easy. As Sandy Hook survivor Emma Ehrens recently told ABC News, "People that have the power to make change should do it – instead of 17, 18 year olds trying to do their work for them." It's really that simple. And it's why I'm determined to defeat Brian Fitzpatrick and be the fighter for policy and change that every single one of us deserves from our elected leaders. # Hello Team,

Election Day is just a few weeks away, and everyone from Speaker Mike Johnson to President Donald Trump has endorsed Congressman Andy Ogles for reelection. That’s because they know he is a steadfast defender of conservative values and a tireless advocate for our principles, with a proven track record of getting things done.

Below, you will find information on some of Congressman Ogles’ exciting new endorsements, legislative scorecards, and a brief update on the state of this race.

Lastly, if you’d like to volunteer, need a new “Endorsed by Trump” yard sign, or would like to host an event, please don’t hesitate to let us know by **[clicking HERE.](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=8a8ec54253&e=0ad50b23ec)
[](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=3eee8b1ff2&e=0ad50b23ec)**

| [JOIN TEAM OGLES](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=c92c72b614&e=0ad50b23ec "JOIN TEAM OGLES")
---
|
---
|
---
_PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP_
"Since his first day in Washington, Andy has not backed down from the challenges of draining the swamp and getting the country back on track. As a representative, Andy has introduced, cosponsored, and voted for legislation to secure our southern border, stop inflation, uphold the rule of law, and defend the Second Amendment—just like I knew he would. Andy Ogles has demonstrated he is truly dedicated to putting America First and **__he has my complete support and endorsement!"__**

_SENATOR TED CRUZ_
"Andy Ogles has remained unwavering in the fight for our nation in the House. He has done an excellent job representing the people of Tennessee's 5th Congressional District and has been a steadfast leader against the radically woke agenda sweeping across our nation. I have had the pleasure of working with Andy already this Congress and look forward to continuing to work together. I am proud to endorse him for re-election."

_SENATOR BILL HAGERTY_
"I'm pleased to endorse my friend and fellow Tennessean, Andy Ogles, for re-election. Andy has demonstrated that he is a fearless fighter for freedom, and his commitment to securing our border and protecting our national security is nearly unparalleled. As a member of the Financial Services Committee, Andy has worked to increase government transparency in the financial sector and advocated for increased security measures to combat foreign threats. He truly represents the values of Middle Tennessee in Washington, and I'm pleased to endorse Andy Ogles for re-election in the 5th Congressional District."

_CONGRESSMAN JIM JORDAN_
"Andy Ogles is a conservative, fully dedicated to representing the people of Middle Tennessee in the 5th District. He has fought for government transparency and accountability of the Biden Administration. Andy works hard to uphold the Constitution, protect traditional values, and rein in government spending."
|

**_"Congressman Andy Ogles has set a record for the most stand-alone legislation passed by any freshman in Congress." - Sean Hannity_**
|

| **_State of the Race_**
The Uni-party and Leftists are coming after Congressman Ogles with everything they have. His opponent in this race has a history of sponsoring extremely liberal bills, such as allocating **_nearly four million dollars_** of taxpayer money to **[attorney's fees](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=2e6d0c37ba&e=0ad50b23ec)** for **[immigrants](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=aec90fe829&e=0ad50b23ec)** , sponsoring a **[Transgender Day of Remembrance bill](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=95b354c876&e=0ad50b23ec)** , and giving **_nearly nine million dollars_** of taxpayer money to an organization that conducts woke **[DEI](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=16b493e179&e=0ad50b23ec)** and **[racial sensitivity](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=37661d24b1&e=0ad50b23ec)** workplace training. Furthermore, his opponent has filled her campaign team with **[outspoken Never-Trumpers](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=349a9a4396&e=0ad50b23ec)** , actively working against President Trump in the past and **[trashing his name on social media](https://andyogles.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ebf5c4144eb35f4cf4004f6c&id=fef34c834f&e=0ad50b23ec)**. Now, they're doing everything in their power to stop Congressman Ogles from standing up for you! At a time when the entire Deep State is weaponized against President Trump, **_we cannot afford to have someone in office who is so heavily influenced by people fighting against Trump's agenda and whose policies mirror those of Joe Biden._**

Congressman Ogles said it best himself: “I ran for Congress because I believe in serving the people of Tennessee’s Fifth District above all else. I believe in standing up for everyday Americans in Congress. I believe in standing in the gap and fighting for freedom when no one else will. I will never back down—I’m unapologetically in this for YOU! That’s exactly why they’re spending MILLIONS to keep me down. They’re scared that I don’t fit their mold.” We would be honored if you would consider contributing whatever you can to ensure that Congressman Ogles can continue to fight for you.

Hello,
It’s hard to explain what it feels like to turn on the TV or get on social media and see ads attacking your dad with lie after lie.
When Dad decided to run against Lauren Boebert in 2022, my parents tried to warn my sister and me what would happen. It’s one thing to imagine what it’ll feel like; it’s another to experience it. Especially when the attacks got really, really nasty.
My dad, Adam Frisch, barely lost in 2022 to Lauren Boebert. It was just 546 votes. I really thought he might pull it off when things went to a recount. But unfortunately, we lost in the closest race in the country.
Now, Dad’s scared off Boebert – and I _know_ he’s going to win this seat in 2024. But the Super PAC attacks have already started...

Friends,
This doesn't add up. Rep. Bergman lives in a $1.5 million home in DC, yet claims he would have to "sleep on a cot" if he didn’t receive record-setting lodging reimbursements.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]

CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
I have slept in spare hospital beds while providing overnight ER care. I've spent nights in shipping containers while serving as a Diplomat in the Middle East, traveling from our modest one-bedroom apartment at the Embassy.
I was even on duty during the birth of my daughter. My opponent can't seem to handle the sacrifices necessary to serve.
Bergman has three homes. His primary residence is outside the district in Louisiana. He makes three times the median income of residents his "home" county, but he claims it as a homestead to deny our district's schools of crucial taxes.
Bergman votes against food stamps and yet charges taxpayers the most of any member of Congress for his own meal reimbursements.
Jack Bergman isn't working for the people — they're working for him, they're paying his bills, and he's working for himself.
I'm running for Congress to serve.
I'll proudly take the cot.
-Dr. Bob

Fellow American,

We have a major development in my race to flip CA-9.

My Democrat opponent, Josh Harder, was just placed on the House Democrats’ Frontline program, _ \*\*reserved for the most vulnerable incumbents they’re afraid of losing.\*\* _

Democrats know that our grassroots campaign has gained serious momentum, \*\*and CA-9 is in play.\*\*

I’m a Marine Corps veteran, Mayor, father, husband, and patriotic American who is tired of watching my community and country suffer under failed leadership.

Josh Harder and Joe Biden have been a disaster, and it’s time to get things back on track.

\*\*This seat is up for grabs, and I’m asking you to chip in $5, $25, or whatever you can to send a Marine and Mayor to fight for you in Congress.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=12330585.5135.1.23b78fe5834ac3df48e0e50447f3e1dd{{campaignId}} )

->

->\*\*Meet Kevin Lincoln

\*\*<-

My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Well, up to that point, anyway. (The bar exam was still a few weeks away).

Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.

As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would handle a case like that.

Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country ...

...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...

...serve on the January 6 Committee...

...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House for doing the above...

...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the personal threat of that corrupt president...

Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I have been in a position to help do something about it.

In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

I am grateful.

My entire team has worked incredibly hard since I got into this race, and now we're all going to redouble our efforts to ensure Jon Tester's current term is his last.

[**This email is long and alarming, but I'm hoping you'll read it through and then consider donating to my campaign so I can fight to prevent stories like this from happening again.**](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=b58a6fa7bbd64d8da26b2bc714d849a0&_e=InCGeSAt_-IonHZNe7SUWkYXEBvAWO6sm5fVq3ff3SmGo5H0NKwoBOeMDZq7s0vkWeBWUX0aje5JKRh0_4p9k81Zmq4SIkTlhrVTVEGUwLrr_7gCLhCEILs3gIveHbygY2E4WBmMTQ95Y0kG0b_5keo6axEK7Ta_9VlXNQZmzZ4b6PrylHB-KkQ1Unq_yk70dyuXdcsMAk93wOuKRRdEFAlfbOLpLFelpcvhQO6gKxP9p_HGMQvQD-yUFkcRrYqu50bFuoyyvfkAbyIumKZjGGe7FcmTVLdVn8vEe-Zz_-rAXiUXxTeYFG5fBBsKDpxZaz6bWQeIdoVRTiNxGBIaZOgv0jVBLmTuqx-ajFC9c35wviosHPS824ODiO4TCBleToSAJDAwi1HrdhFk2z0JVC9ECHmKoiBlBzhgv638tuQ%3D)

I wanted to share with you some of the horror stories that have happened as a result of a porous and open Southern Border. These tragedies fall at the feet of Joe Biden and his Liberal cronies, who support leaving the Southern Border WIDE OPEN.

All of these horrific incidents could have been prevented with Republican leadership in Congress and the White House...

_**Laken Riley**_

Laken Riley's story took the headlines on all major media outlets in 2024 after she was viciously attacked, almost raped, and killed by an illegal immigrant out of Venezuela. The monster who took her life visited Laken's university in the morning and spied on students and potential victims. Later that day, he stalked and killed Laken, who was a 22-year-old nursing student at the University of Georgia with her entire life ahead of her.

In response to the murder, President Biden downplayed the story and said, "Laken Riley, an innocent young woman who was killed by an illegal. That's right, but how many thousands of people are killed by legals?"

_**Kate Steinle**_

Kate Steinle was taking a walk with her father and friend on Pier 14 in San Francisco in July 2015 when she was suddenly shot and collapsed into her father's arms. Her killer was an illegal immigrant from Mexico who had been released from prison three months prior despite a request by federal immigration authorities to detain him for deportation. Because San Francisco is a sanctuary city, local law enforcement was barred from cooperating with federal immigration authorities.

When the killer was tried in court, he was acquitted of the murder charges and only was found guilty of possession of an illegal firearm, which he stole from a federal ranger a week earlier. He was deported shortly thereafter, but not soon enough for Kate Steinle.

_**Terry and Brenda Aultman**_

Terry and Brenda Aultman were brutally stabbed to death with their throats slashed as they rode their bikes home together from Bike Week in Daytona Beach, Florida, in 2022. The killer was a mentally competent illegal immigrant out of Haiti. Daytona Beach Police Department Chief Jakari Young said the slaying was "probably one of the most vicious and gruesome incidents that I've witnessed in my 20 years."

The killer was a known criminal who had multiple prior drug charges in Orange County, but the State Attorney dropped the charges in 2020 for unknown reasons. The Aultmans suffered at the hands of an illegal immigrant who should not have been in our country but was thanks to a combination of an open border and Liberal State Attorneys who side with Illegals over U.S. citizens.

_**Massachusetts Child Raped**_

In early 2024, an illegal immigrant out of Columbia was arrested in Lynn, Massachusetts, for raping a minor over 14 years old. The rapist was stopped at the Southern Border in July 2022 and was released into the U.S. Two years later, he raped his child victim and was briefly arrested in January, before Essex County released him again despite ICE lodging an immigration detainer order. It was not until Match 28 that the illegal immigrant was arrested again.

**I know this was a painful read, but too often, we talk about the Border Crisis in passing and forget about the real American lives that it affects. I thought it was important to show you real-life examples of Biden's failed border policies.**

I vow to always fight for a safe and secure border if elected into Congress. My opponent, and PA-08's incumbent, has repeatedly sided with Nancy Pelosi's radical agenda, advocating for an open border and for sanctuary states. Laken Riley, Kate Steinle, Terry, Brenda Aultman, and the Massachusetts child would all agree that America is NOT safer with Biden's border policies.

**It's up to us to change it.**
With your help, I'll fight against the Radical Left's dangerous border policy, and I'll work with fellow conservatives to secure our Southern Border and end the crisis. I will fight to make our country safe again.

[**I'm humbly asking you to donate any amount to my campaign to help me beat Matt Cartwright, flip PA-08 red, and secure our border. Friend, trust me — I’ve been called a lot worse by Donald Trump and his MAGA cronies.
**What concerns me far more is how Trump, in this very interview and numerous other recent campaign events, has explicitly called for revenge against his political rivals._Rivals like me. Like his call to prosecute me and other members of the January 6 Committee._**
God forbid Trump makes it back to the White House, he will use his powers to seek retribution against the people who have held him accountable for his crimes and disgraceful behavior. Including me.
He tried to do this during his first term, and he lashed out at his former attorney general for not going after rivals with baseless investigations and lawsuits. **But if he’s president for a second time, he’ll only appoint cabinet officials who do exactly what he wants.**
Donald Trump has promised to be a dictator on day one. He admires leaders like Vladimir Putin and Kim Jong Un. That’s the risk he poses to our country.

Peter, I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift.
And I know we send a lot of emails already, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.
The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point.
But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump.
And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really.
**She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip.**
One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.

# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=6760%2E5257348%2EfUQ_cn)
Derek — I’m away from my computer right now as I celebrate my birthday with my wife, Eve, but I just had to take a moment to say thank you.
Because in the last year, since I was censured by the GOP in a blatantly partisan move, **you’ve stepped up in a big way.**
Through every attack lobbed at me, you’ve stood by my side.
When I’ve asked for your help, you’ve answered and offered your support.
During the most difficult moments of this campaign, you’ve reassured me that I’m doing the right thing:

clean_body: | ~ Peter, I’ve gotten a lot of pushback since I first announced I was running for Congress. People said I was too young. That I didn’t look or act like a Congressman. That my legislative priorities were too pie-in-the-sky. But there’s one subject Republicans can’t get enough of attacking me for: not being rich. What they don’t realize is that their favorite attack line is actually something we need more of. We need and deserve young, working, everyday people in Congress who know firsthand the struggles of the working class – and I’m proud to represent us. But increasing our ranks means building an unbeatable organizing movement, and to do that, I need as much grassroots support as I can get. I need you , Peter. ~ | ~ I’ll never apologize for having humble beginnings – because my family fought to give me what chances I’ve had. My abuela, mom, and aunt fled Cuba in the 1960s with no money, and without knowing English. My abuela worked multiple factory jobs just to give her kids a better shot. It’s her legacy I’m carrying forward when I walk onto the House floor, Peter. Because working people know – we’re in this together. But let’s be real: You shouldn’t have to be working class to care about working class priorities. You don’t need to be rejected by an apartment, or become houseless, or drive Uber to make ends meet – all of which I’ve done – to know that our economy isn’t working for everybody. On Wednesday, the far-right majority on the Supreme Court is poised to issue more opinions on cases ranging from immunity for Donald Trump to access to emergency abortion care. And on Thursday, President Biden is set to face off against Trump in the earliest general election presidential debate in recent memory. With so much happening, we thought it was a good time to check in on how you are feeling about the current political moment. Our monthly WFP Pulse Survey is one of the best ways to let us know your thoughts, and we depend on your participation — whether this is your first time or whether you have taken one of our surveys in the past. To get started, here's the first question: The Working Families Party and our grassroots movement are fighting for working people across the country — which means that your priorities are deeply important to our mission. That’s why we try to check in regularly to hear your thoughts on how our government is handling the most important issues of the day and other timely questions. Every time you participate in one of our monthly pulse surveys, you’re helping us stay informed about the views of WFP members from across the country — and helping to guide our party's priorities as we move through this critical election year. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. clean_body: I need you to hear this!If you don't open, thousands won't hear THIS message! | Patriot, When people ask me why I serve in Congress, here's what I tell them: serving my country is all I've ever really wanted to do. Service runs in my family, and I love this country with every fiber of my being. I proudly served my country overseas in Afghanistan, and now I proudly serve my country in the Halls of Congress. What we have here in the United States is the envy of every other nation in the world: freedom to speak our minds, freedom to choose what is best for ourselves, and freedom to live our American Dreams. I want my kids to grow up knowing this life - not the life of socialism. That's why I will fight for these freedoms with the tenacity I did in war. Our country deserves nothing less from its representatives in Congress. This year, I want to keep up this fight and help Republicans hold the House, flip the Senate, and take back the White House from Joe Biden. You see, if Democrats take full control in November, our children and grandchildren won't experience the freedoms and liberties our country was founded on. Americans need to hear this before Democrats and their mega-donors flood their inboxes full of far-left propaganda. | Let's remember:the freedoms we have in America won't endure unless we fight for them. I lost both of my legs while fighting terrorists in Afghanistan when a Taliban bomb blew up beneath me. I'm sure as hell not going to let the same thing happen here. I'm going to keep up my service for America by helping our America First movement takeover in November, fighting Democrat tyranny in the Halls of Congress, and making sure this remains the greatest nation on the planet. Thank you for reading this and for taking action. When you contribute, I personally make note of every name that comes in to make sure I can send my thanks later on! clean_body: The response to Trump's guilty verdict gave him a boost. | | Derek -- We've sent a few emails about the huge sums of money the Republican National Committee and the Trump campaign raised after Trump's guilty verdict, but we thought it important to explain why this is so dangerous. First, it goes without saying that Trump's fundraising surge allows him to attack Joe Biden in ads he had not previously budgeted for. That's a problem. But practically, when you look at some of the big "swing" states in this election, they are also states with big Senate races up for grabs: like Michigan, Wisconsin, Pennsylvania... states Democrats need to win to hold onto our Senate majority. So the better Trump does there, the better Republicans will do in those Senate campaigns and any competitive House races in those states. The same is true for Democrats. If we can raise the resources we need to win, we can defeat Trump, help hold the Senate, and flip the House. The response to Trump's guilty verdict gave him a boost. Now it's up to Democrats who want to defeat the MAGA right to answer. name: Dr. Marilyn Harper
subject: Reaching out on my son’s behalf
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
I may be biased, but I know Hill will make us all proud.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D)
Hello there, Peter. In case we haven’t met yet, I’m Marilyn Harper — Hill’s mom. I can’t just go talking about my son without sharing a picture, so here’s one of my favorites with my grandson Pierce, too ♥️
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1332?t=2&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D)
**[DONATE TO HILL HARPER FOR SENATE](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1748?t=3&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D)**
**You probably know that Hill played a doctor on TV, but what you might not know is that Hill himself comes from a family of doctors!** My husband Harry and I both enjoyed long careers in the medical field — he as a psychiatrist, and me as one of the first Black practicing anesthesiologists in the country.
I have no doubt that growing up in our house inspired Hill’s role as “Dr. Hawkes” in _CSI_ and “Dr. Andrews” in _The Good Doctor_ , but I know his passion for equality and healthcare justice was inspired by my own father, Dr. Harold Hill. You see, he was also a pharmacist, one who built his business under Jim Crow. At the time, Black folks weren’t welcome at Rexall or Walgreens, so they went to my father’s pharmacy instead, where young Hill spent the summertime eating popsicles and reading comic books.
Some customers who were in need would barter, trading a sack of potatoes or chickens for prescriptions. Some customers had neither money nor something to trade. But even when they couldn’t pay up, my father provided the prescribed medicine and recorded the transaction in his ledger — something that I know sank into Hill as he sat there, drinking a lemon-lime rickey and reading his books.
**Like his grandfather before him, Hill fiercely believes that no one should go bankrupt because they can’t afford life-saving medical care or medications.** Whether it stems from his own experience battling cancer as an adult or watching my father put people before profits as a child — or both — I’m proud to see Hill fighting for the values Harry and I worked so hard to instill in him.
Peter, that’s how I know Hill will make you proud, too. I never thought my son would run for office, but here we are — and he needs our help! **[It would mean the world to both of us if you would chip in to help Hill win this race for Michigan’s future. Any amount makes a difference, and I know Hill and his team will be so grateful to have your support.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1748?t=4&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D)**
_If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[DONATE $5 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1749?t=5&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D) [DONATE $25 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1750?t=6&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D) [DONATE $50 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1751?t=7&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D) [DONATE $100 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1752?t=8&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D) [DONATE $250 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1753?t=9&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D) [OTHER AMOUNT »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1748?t=10&akid=1279%2E62735%2EUv_b3D)
---
Thank you so much!
\- Dr. Marilyn Harper

Peter, I didn’t grow up with power or privilege.
I was born and raised in a working-class family in one of Brooklyn’s many diverse neighborhoods. Throughout my entire childhood and into my young adulthood, I had no real platform to voice my opinions or speak out against the decisions that were _directly_ affecting me and my family.
So when I made history in 2018 by becoming the first Black lawmaker ever to serve as New York’s attorney general, I vowed that – _no matter what_ – I would be a voice for the voiceless and speak for those who had been silenced for so long.
**I’m proud to say that I’ve kept that promise – and this Priorities Survey is a key part of keeping it to this day.**
**[So please, will you be one of the 5,000 people I need to take my June Priorities Survey before midnight tonight?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87407099/481047654/717631208?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=15&amounts=15,25,50,100,250&code=jtk1492-su-nd&refcode=jtk1492-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NGExZGFkYi1lNDMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nbPB-vXSLqBLKZWkk2zB7qLRo17eO175VtHod9KrtmY=&emci=a49d3061-292f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=94a1dadb-e430-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=25369504)**

It was a common-sense decision — yet just the week prior, they overturned a ban on the bump stocks that turn guns into even deadlier automatic weapons. Time and again, we have seen this Supreme Court and congressional Republicans cave to the National Rifle Association and the gun lobby. My opponent is cut from the same cloth — **in the Connecticut Senate, George Logan voted _against_ a bipartisan ban on bump stocks and other deadly gun modifications after the Las Vegas shooting.** He called the bill a _“waste of time”_ and a _“political stunt,”_ saying it _“really wasn’t an issue for Connecticut residents”_ — in a state that suffered one of the worst mass shootings tragedies in American history. Such callous dismissiveness is a moral offense. But it does not end there — my opponent voted against bipartisan safe storage legislation that required gun owners to better secure unattended firearms left in vehicles. He blamed “other factors” than a lack of gun safety for violence in America, and said there was no further need for gun safety measures in Connecticut. It was a common-sense decision — yet just the week prior, they overturned a ban on the bump stocks that turn guns into even deadlier automatic weapons. Time and again, we have seen this Supreme Court and congressional Republicans cave to the National Rifle Association and the gun lobby. My opponent is cut from the same cloth — in the Connecticut Senate, George Logan voted against a bipartisan ban on bump stocks and other deadly gun modifications after the Las Vegas shooting. He called the bill a “waste of time” and a “political stunt,” saying it “really wasn’t an issue for Connecticut residents” — in a state that suffered one of the worst mass shootings tragedies in American history. Such callous dismissiveness is a moral offense. But it does not end there — my opponent voted against bipartisan safe storage legislation that required gun owners to better secure unattended firearms left in vehicles. name: Jon Hamm
subject: There’s an important U.S. Senate race I think you need to know about
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
#

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-kunce-split.ni0OFm&refcode=em240622-3-160&refcode2=2518.734936.3CJzIk&t=1&akid=2518%2E734936%2E3CJzIk)
---
Hey Peter, it's Jon Hamm.
**There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.**
So before I ask you to support my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.
[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-kunce-split.ni0OFm&refcode=em240622-3-160&t=2&akid=2518%2E734936%2E3CJzIk)
Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.**
[ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-kunce-split.ni0OFm&refcode=em240622-3-160&t=3&akid=2518%2E734936%2E3CJzIk)
Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only reason he’s incapable of representing my home state.
**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself.**
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-kunce-split.ni0OFm&refcode=em240622-3-160&t=4&akid=2518%2E734936%2E3CJzIk)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about _“Manhood.”_
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-kunce-split.ni0OFm&refcode=em240622-3-160&t=5&akid=2518%2E734936%2E3CJzIk)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, Peter, and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
**_Morning Consult_ reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November.** And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
After spending a whole year consolidating support from workers, community leaders, and organizations across Missouri, Lucas Kunce has more than proved that he has what it takes to win this race. Multiple polls even confirm he’s in a dead heat with Hawley. That’s why I’m asking for your help, Peter:
[**Will you join me in supporting my friend Lucas Kunce by splitting a donation of any amount between his campaign and Ruben Gallego today?
